papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，该方法在三种骨干模型上均取得了强劲的整体性能，并验证了经验引导的预测控制的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种受MPPI启发的测试时框架，结合多分支预测分析和基于经验的适应机制，并引入双分支经验记忆实现自我改进。
analysis.method: 在每个步骤中，智能体提出多个候选动作，利用世界模型预测其结果，通过评估任务进展和风险得到代价，再用MPPI风格的权重指导最终决策；双分支经验记忆分别用于改进候选生成/动作选择和下一观察预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种测试时框架，结合多分支预测分析与经验自适应，使LLM智能体在文本环境中实现自改进决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文的核心是世界模型在决策中的应用，尽管实验在文本环境（ALFWorld和ScienceWorld）中，其世界模型与预测控制框架对机器人世界模型（WAM）和策略学习具有方法论启示，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人操作。

papers.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class experimental axis in CP evaluations for language-model systems.

analysis.key_results: 匹配协议评估可能显著高估部署时的覆盖率，且影响在不同模型和数据集间存在异质性。
analysis.main_contribution: 形式化并实证研究了推理时模型偏移对共形预测的影响，指出匹配协议评估会高估部署时的覆盖率，并建议将推理配置作为共形预测评估的第一级实验轴。
analysis.method: 理论刻画推理配置变化对共形分数分布的影响，并通过在8个语言模型、4个有限标签基准和12种推理配置上进行实验验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文揭示了推理配置（尤其是量化）变化会导致共形预测的交换性假设失效，从而使得校准后的预测覆盖保证在部署时不可靠。

papers.abstract: Human video scales easily and does not need robot hardware, but existing methods require depth sensing, overlay the robot onto 2D video, or generate data only for the demonstrated objects. We present Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R), a real-to-semantic-to-real pipeline that turns one monocular RGB video of a human demonstration into thousands of robot demonstrations across the semantic object instances of a category. R2Sem2R tracks the SE(3) pose of each object with DINOv3-distilled Gaussian splats, outperforming existing methods and FoundationPose with estimated metric depth. R2Sem2R then aligns digital cousins, each generated from one or a few photographs, to the demonstrated objects with a semantic alignment. This alignment matches whole objects and the functional regions of target objects, such as a coffee machine's tray. R2Sem2R maps the human hand to a feasible robot grasp that extends to the cousins. Robot demonstrations are generated either in IsaacSim, for photorealistic rendering, or MuJoCo, for contact physics, and R2Sem2R can generate over 2,000 episodes in about two hours. On two real robots and four tasks, we train a vision-language-action policy on data from one human video per task, and policies trained on our data match or exceed policies trained on teleoperation across diverse object instances. The project page is available at https://real2sem2real.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在四个任务和两个真实机器人上，基于单个视频生成的数据训练VLA策略，性能匹配或超过基于遥操作训练的策略；演示生成速度快，约两小时可生成超过2000个episode。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Real2Sem2Real管线，仅需单个人体RGB演示视频，即可生成数千个跨语义对象类别的机器人演示，训练的策略在真实机器人上匹配或超越基于遥操作训练的策略。
analysis.method: 使用DINOv3蒸馏的高斯泼溅跟踪每个对象的SE(3)位姿；通过语义对齐匹配数字孪生与演示对象，包括功能区域；将人手映射为机器人抓取；在IsaacSim或MuJoCo中生成机器人演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Real2Sem2Real是一个真实到语义再到真实的管线，将单个人体RGB演示视频转化为跨语义对象实例的机器人演示数据，用于训练视觉-语言-动作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人学习中的数据扩展问题，通过单个人体视频生成多样化机器人演示，用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，属于VLA数据生成与仿真增强范畴，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient {\lambda} setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the reshaped weights do less damage, a plain gradient-norm penalty does not reproduce the effect, and a preliminary extension to three small language models shows the same tail shaping. With a BCH code over 1% of the weights the model then survives 300 progressive bit-search flips in every training seed and 500 in two of three, where three of four published defenses with the same code fail by 300 and WCAT falls to 75% at 500. The reshaped distribution also cuts the parity for a fixed guarantee 3.7 times and makes a sensitivity-ordered 8/6/4/3-bit format affordable, which stores ImageNet ResNet-50 at a 3.29-bit weight payload, 2.4 times smaller than INT8, above the accuracy of LSQ at 3 bits.

analysis.key_results: 在九个视觉模型上将敏感尾部缩小 5 至 13 倍，准确率损失在 0.5 点以内；使用 BCH 码覆盖 1% 权重后，模型可承受 300 次渐进位搜索翻转；与 LSQ 相比，ImageNet ResNet-50 在 3.29 位权重负载下达到更高准确率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LEAN 方法，通过复合正则项（范围项和尾部项）系统性地重塑训练后模型的权重敏感性分布，从而提高位翻转容错性并降低量化开销。
analysis.method: 在训练的最后几个 epoch 或微调阶段添加复合正则项，包括限制翻转步长的范围项和降低最敏感权重梯度的尾部项，通过系数 λ 控制分布移动程度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过损失工程调制权重敏感性分布，提升模型对位翻转的容错性并实现更紧凑的非均匀量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于独立的模型量化与错误容忍性研究，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模，其对本站主题的关联在于其量化与容错方法有可能应用于机器人策略网络的推理优化，但摘要未提及相关场景。

papers.abstract: Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). A three-source decomposition localises the amplification to the learned policy (zero ODE-solver contribution, bounded anchor mismatch); the coverage plateau is an unconditional benefit of mode-separating priors that no amount of RL capacity recovers. The remedy is conditional: a non-Gaussian prior is necessary precisely when the latent geometry would fall into overlap and the task is coverage-sensitive. A machine-checked theory skeleton supports the KL pricing structure - a divergent compactness tax under a Gaussian prior versus a finite assignment fee under a mixture - and the position-versus-plateau distinction delimits what is finite-resource from what requires changing the prior.

analysis.key_results: 在真实丙氨酸二肽玻尔兹曼分布上，高斯先验VAE在β_c=0.224崩溃，而模式跟踪的混合高斯先验在0.00316崩溃，相差71倍；几何中介变量为d_min/(2σ_0)；通过受控干预验证因果链。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示高斯先验在RL微调下对多模态潜空间的模式重叠和崩溃的影响，并提出几何中介变量和条件性补救准则。
analysis.method: 理论分析、受控干预实验和机器验证的理论骨架，比较高斯先验与混合高斯先验的VAE。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究RL微调下VAE高斯先验的失效条件，发现多模态数据会导致模式重叠和崩溃，并提出混合高斯先验作为条件性补救。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关于潜空间几何与RL微调，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。但其对多模态潜空间和先验选择的深入分析可能对构建机器人世界模型中的潜空间设计提供方法学参考。

papers.abstract: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.

analysis.key_results: PTQ使NRMSE增加6.25和7.04个百分点，QAT-FT恢复约90.2%和94.5%的损失；累积更新阈值减少约99.7%的更新和77-80%的状态转换，NRMSE仅增加0.042和0.197个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 在极低状态权重量化条件下实现Transformer电力负荷预测的实用性能，并提出累积更新阈值方法以大幅减少权重更新和离散状态转换。
analysis.method: 直接训练后量化（PTQ）、量化感知微调（QAT-FT）、从头量化感知训练（Scratch-QAT）以及所提出的累积更新阈值方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了在3、5、7和16状态权重量化下Transformer电力负荷预测的性能，并提出了累积更新阈值方法来减少权重更新和状态转换。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于模型量化技术，未直接涉及视觉语言动作（VLA）模型、世界行动模型（WAM）或机器人领域，但量化方法可迁移用于机器人模型的高效推理。

papers.abstract: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

analysis.key_results: 在Meta-World、Adroit和DM-Control上，SDI在每个套件的平均任务得分均高于所有对比基线，并在18个任务中有15个达到或超过最强基线；消融实验和鲁棒性分析验证了探索、规划暴露和行动接受的作用，成对评估显示门控比无门控规划更好地恢复演员失败并保留成功行为，同时显著减少回报退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination），通过共享演员参考连接探索与规划决策，无需额外分歧集成即可同时提供探索信号和行动接受准则。
analysis.method: SDI使用世界模型从相同的模型状态想象动作序列，通过重复rollout演员自身序列测量固定行为下的变异，以此缩放候选回报的离散度作为探索信号，并计算计划动作的预测优势来决定是否接受，当优势超过参考变异的一定倍数时执行计划动作，否则遵循演员策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SDI方法，利用世界模型中的同一演员参考比较想象动作序列，统一指导探索与规划，提升智能体在连续控制任务中的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究世界模型中的探索与规划，属于WAM（World-Action Model）核心范畴，其方法可为机器人学习和策略优化提供世界模型驱动的决策机制，但不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或具体机器人操作任务。

papers.abstract: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.

analysis.key_results: 在文本驱动多样骨骼动画方面比视频优先流程更忠实，运动响应周围场景；支持视频到骨骼运动、骨骼运动到视频转换以及基于关键帧的3D运动控制。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个模型，直接为任意提供的骨骼绑定协同生成视频和3D运动，并包含一个将运动注册到场景的相机。
analysis.method: 将3D运动保存在独立模型中，通过少量交叉注意力层与预训练视频模型连接；使用生成式视频编辑器将动画3D资产放置在场景中策展训练数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种协同生成视频与3D运动模型，适用于任意骨骼绑定，并能从视频中恢复相机与3D运动。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于视频生成与世界建模领域，可用于机器人数据生成和运动控制，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型，对本站主题有间接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

analysis.key_results: 在组合拾取放置（MolmoSpaces）和RMBench记忆依赖子集上优于同骨干基线（如FastWAM）；在RMBench上达到34.5%，超过使用关键帧的Mem-0（28.5%），且仅使用单锚帧；真实世界Find-the-Item任务中，文本记忆使成功率从11.1%提升到61.1%，而最先进VLA仅≤33.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniWALM，一个统一的WAM模型，将视频、动作和语言三种模态整合到单一共享表示中，并以同步扩散方式生成，实现语言作为记忆的闭环，无需外部规划器或记忆库；同时引入Flow Matching with Correction (FMC)训练目标。
analysis.method: 采用混合Transformer骨干网络的单一模型，各模态扩散头同步去噪；生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，形成语言记忆循环；FMC通过扰动动作轨迹训练来提高动作流的鲁棒性，且无推理时开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一世界-动作-语言模型UniWALM，在单一扩散Transformer骨干中同步生成视频、动作和文本，并通过语言记忆循环提升操作与记忆依赖任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于WAM领域，将世界模型、动作预测和语言记忆统一到单一模型，对VLA和WAM的发展具有核心意义。

papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.

analysis.key_results: 该设计消除了写入时的字幕生成，并在全部450次测试解码中，缓存令牌解码复现了未拆分模型的输出。
analysis.main_contribution: 一个共享时空记忆系统，通过将视觉编码与语言解码分离、按需生成描述、视觉令牌缓存及PII抽象，扩展了NVIDIA ReMEmbR至机器人车队，提升了隐私保护与计算效率。
analysis.method: 在机器人上使用Jetson进行视频编码（Cosmos-Embed1嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge视觉令牌、Wan2.2 VAE潜变量），将Cosmos3-Edge在视觉-语言边界拆分，视觉编码器留在机器人端，语言解码器置于本地服务器，由Nemotron代理按内容、位置和时间检索记忆并利用缓存的视觉令牌生成描述。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出IndustrialRemembr系统，通过按需生成场景描述、在机器人端编码视觉信息并缓存视觉令牌的服务器端解码，降低车队规模机器人共享时空记忆的算力与通信成本。

papers.abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（Medusa头）、Meta MTP模型和Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP上，于AIME 2025和GSM8K评测，AMTP最高比标准解码快4.1倍，在10个设置中有8个匹配或优于固定窗口，吞吐量增益最高达10%。
analysis.main_contribution: 将MTP的horizon选择形式化为在线控制问题，提出AMTP轻量级控制器，利用验证反馈学习不同上下文中可信的草稿长度，无需重训练且不改动验证器。
analysis.method: 采用接受生存概率刻画每个horizon的期望接受令牌数，每轮解码前由AMTP预测草稿可能存活的距离，选择期望每秒令牌数最高的horizon；使用在线梯度下降实现次线性遗憾。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AMTP控制器，在线学习多令牌预测（MTP）的最佳推测horizon，无需重训练且保持验证器不变，能提升解码吞吐量。

papers.abstract: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $\pi_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

analysis.key_results: 在四个真实世界操作任务中，世界模型策略评估与真实成功率的任务级 Pearson 相关算术平均值从 0.602 提升至 0.885；策略后训练使 π0.5 的平均真实成功率从 59.1% 的 SFT 基线提升至 70.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PhysCanvas，一个状态一致的视觉触觉世界模型，统一多视图 RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态和动作，并通过一致性感知后训练提升策略评估与学习的可靠性。
analysis.method: 使用统一的视频 VAE 和预训练生成骨干网络，结合正向运动学和相机投影生成的运动图像进行空间对齐的动作条件化，并利用初始 RGB 锚点和更新参考观测引导序列生成；采用冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型和状态奖励模型进行一致性感知后训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PhysCanvas 提出一个统一多模态视觉触觉世界模型，通过一致性感知后训练来支持接触丰富机器人操作任务的策略评估与强化学习。

papers.abstract: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.

analysis.key_results: 在VP-WorldBench和现有4D生成基准上，点监督提升了视频保真度和3D运动精度；在仿真与真实机器人实验中，动作模型的操作成功率有所提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出视频-点模型（VPM），一个以多视角视频和语言指令为条件、同时预测未来任意视角视频及持久3D点轨迹的世界模型，并扩展到机器人控制。
analysis.method: 扩展预训练世界模型，加入相机条件多视角处理与轨迹头；轨迹与视频联合监督；控制扩展将机器人动作作为token，与未来视频联合去噪。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出视频-点模型，通过联合预测多视角未来视频和持久3D点轨迹，并在同一3D感知表示下扩展到机器人控制，以提升动态场景理解与操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于世界模型（WAM）范畴，通过3D点轨迹监督增强动态场景建模，并扩展到机器人控制，与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）及机器人世界模型的核心主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

analysis.key_results: 在指令跟随、推理和编码任务上，流模型达到或超过自回归模型质量；自推测解码吞吐量是自回归模型的2.54倍，优于多token预测和离散扩散方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出大型流式语言模型Lafa，可扩展到80亿参数，支持前缀缓存和块并行解码，并通过自推测解码实现2.54倍吞吐量提升。
analysis.method: 块状流模型（因果前缀注意力+双向异步流），从预训练自回归模型改编，采用自推测解码（流草稿自回归验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种可扩展的连续流语言模型Lafa，通过块状流建模与自推测解码实现高效并行生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于语言模型的高效推理，不涉及VLA或世界模型，但其推测解码技术可潜在应用于机器人策略模型的加速推理。

(Bottom) Lafa supports flow decoding, which can be further distilled into a flow map for one-step generation. Together, AR and flow support self-speculative decoding, which accepts flow-based drafts from left to right via AR verification.

papers.abstract: Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在32个独立采样的计算图目标上，LeWi是未给定目标图时样本效率最高的方法，平均学习曲线面积比密集网络低27%；在17个世界模型预测任务上，LeWi在16个任务上优于密集基线，并在119个基线比较中赢得99个。
analysis.limitations: 密集网络在单一高元数函数目标上表现更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Learned Wiring（LeWi）方法，让每个神经元具有可学习的低维嵌入，仅邻近神经元连接，嵌入和权重联合训练，从而利用隐藏的组合结构提高样本效率。
analysis.method: Learned Wiring（LeWi）：神经元学习低维嵌入，依据嵌入空间中的邻近性确定连接，嵌入和权重联合训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了学习连接（LeWi）方法，通过神经元的低维嵌入和邻近连接来学习计算结构，以提高在组合稀疏目标上的样本效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文提出一种学习计算结构的方法，并在世界模型预测任务（包括控制、导航、操作）上验证了其提高样本效率的有效性，与WAM主题存在方法学关联，但未涉及VLA。

papers.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
papers.title_zh: 学习计算结构以实现样本高效预测

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. Furthermore, at a short recovery budget, calibration and recovery data are coupled. The best recovery data depends on the calibration data, so the two must be chosen jointly. The resulting recipe involves a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and an inexpensive codebook-only recovery stage. Including codebooks, it uses about $2.3$ effective bits per weight and retains $89$ to $97\%$ of full-precision question-answering (QA) accuracy where scalar PTQ is at chance, and, including recovery, uses $1.4$ to $30\times$ less compute than the strongest quantization-aware-training (QAT) baseline.

analysis.key_results: 2比特下，标量PTQ降至随机水平；向量码本恢复可提升准确率；QA任务保留89-97%全精度准确率，计算量比最强QAT基线少1.4-30倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种面向2比特训练后量化的数据中心配方，包括向量码本表示、任务对齐的小型校准混合和仅码本恢复阶段，在QA任务上保留89-97%全精度准确率，计算量比最强QAT基线少1.4-30倍。
analysis.method: 使用向量码本作为量化表示，结合任务对齐的校准数据混合和码本恢复微调；校准与恢复数据联合选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究2比特训练后量化中表示、校准数据与恢复微调数据的选择，提出向量码本和联合校准/恢复数据配方，在低计算预算下恢复模型精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文研究独立于机器人领域的模型量化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略/世界模型。但其高效推理技术（2比特量化与恢复）可潜在应用于机器人模型的部署压缩，具有方法学参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
papers.title_zh: 超越4比特：以数据为中心的训练后量化与恢复

papers.abstract: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上，对五种接触丰富交互进行评估；语义接触建模显著提高了演示交互的保持度，生成式伙伴状态建模在五种交互中的四种上改善了接触召回率；真实硬件上机器人仅使用机载传感执行了所有交互。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出REACT框架，利用语义接触结构作为关键监督信号，连接演示处理、交互学习和机载控制，并通过VLM引导接触建模和生成式伙伴状态建模实现从人-人演示到人形机器人的策略迁移。
analysis.method: VLM引导的接触建模与重定向流水线，接触感知奖励的特权交互策略学习，光真实感人体深度渲染的蒸馏，以及生成式伙伴状态建模目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: REACT框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的接触建模和生成式伙伴状态建模，从人-人演示中学习可部署的人形机器人交互策略，以应对严重部分可观测性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究属于机器人操作与视觉语言模型（VLM）交叉领域，利用VLM进行接触语义理解，并通过生成式建模处理部分可观测性，对VLA在接触丰富交互中的实际部署具有直接参考价值；但未明确涉及世界模型（WAM）的概念。

papers.abstract: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

analysis.key_results: 在 H20 上，混合解码在 BitNet b1.58-2B 上平均加速 2.2 倍，在 1.7B-4B Bonsai 模型上加速 2.1-2.4 倍；在 RTX 3090 和 Jetson Orin 上分别实现高达 2.0 倍和 3.3 倍吞吐量提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 BitMTP，一个算法-系统协同设计框架，通过联合训练目标、多种解码策略和系统优化，在超低比特 LLM 骨干上实现高效多令牌预测推理。
analysis.method: 联合下一令牌预测与 MTP 目标、置信度解码、纯推测解码、混合解码、接受前缀对齐，以及宽度专用低比特执行和存储复用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 BitMTP 算法-系统协同设计框架，用于在超低比特 LLM 骨干上高效进行多令牌预测（MTP）推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于语言模型的高效推理，未直接涉及 VLA 或世界模型；但其提出的超低比特骨干上的多令牌预测加速技术可能对资源受限的机器人应用具有借鉴价值。

figures.caption: Five-task mean generation quality (%) and decode throughput (tokens/s) for BitNet b1.58-2B-SFT AR, Naive BitNet + + MTP, and the proposed BitMTP on NVIDIA H20. The left panel shows the results by using BF16 reference execution, while the right panel uses low-bit W2A8 execution (2-bit weights and 8-bit activations). We see that the naive combination on BF16 improves throughput, but it loses both throughput and quality in the low-bit W2A8 setting. In contrast, our BitMTP substantially increases throughput while retaining task quality comparable to SFT AR.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: The BitMTP framework. (a) Joint NTP + + MTP training supports mask-conditioned block-causal drafting and an AR path in one model. (b) Confidence-only decoding commits a confidence-selected prefix. Speculative-only decoding verifies each block, while hybrid decoding verifies when the confidence prefix is too short. Verifier-based steps add a correction or bonus token. (c) The runtime executes accepted-prefix transitions with width-specialized low-bit operators and captured CUDA Graphs. Graphs reuse causal KV history through shared storage. In hybrid decoding, verifier inputs are prepared before the host branch decision.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: BitMTP：当多令牌预测遇上低比特大型语言模型

papers.abstract: Deep State-Space Models (Deep SSMs) have shown promising performance and computational benefits in processing of time-series data with complex temporal dependencies. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) constitute a biologically inspired class of deep SSMs, where computing blocks communicate through spikes, discrete single-bit events rather than continuous activation functions. A particularly important task in time-series processing is forecasting, i.e. predicting future values of a sequence from past observations alone. However, how to best perform forecasting with SNNs is an open question, where the standard autoregressive nature of the data processing with SNNs requires values that are not available during the forecasting phase. In this article, we address this challenge. We explore two closed-loop forecasting strategies, in which the network's own generated values are fed back into the network as if they were observed past values: (i) model-level and (ii) layer-level closed-loop forecasting. We evaluate these approaches on the ETT-small datasets, a standard benchmark for time-series forecasting, under both spike-based and continuous activation functions. We compare the proposed closed-loop approaches against state-of-the-art methods such as SpaceTime, as well as the zero-masking baseline in S4. Both of the proposed approaches perform comparably to or better than zero-masking with S4, and in most cases match SpaceTime. These findings highlight the trade-off between continuous and low-bit quantized activations, and demonstrate that the proposed Deep SSM architectures provide a competitive framework for forecasting.

analysis.key_results: 在ETT-small时间序列预测基准上，两种闭环方法性能与S4零掩码基线相当或更好，多数情况下达到SpaceTime水平。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出两种闭环预测策略（模型级和层级），将网络自身生成的值反馈作为观测输入，解决SNN在预测阶段缺乏未来值的问题。
analysis.method: 利用深度状态空间模型（SSM）和脉冲神经网络（SNN），在预测阶段采用模型级或层级闭环反馈，将网络生成值作为输入。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对脉冲神经网络在时间序列预测中因自回归特性难以获取未来值的问题，提出模型级和层级两种闭环预测策略，并在基准数据集上验证其性能接近现有方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦脉冲神经网络（SNN）的高效时间序列预测，通过低比特量化激活实现计算优势。虽未涉及VLA或WAM，但其低比特量化技术与高效推理相关，对机器人策略中的时间序列建模可能具有借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: Learning latent dynamics is fundamental to building action-conditioned world models for planning. Among existing families, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a natural framework by modeling transitions directly in latent space rather than at the pixel level. However, two issues remain in JEPA-based world models: (i) physical grounding lacks explicit aggregation of temporal context and (ii) action planning always overly relies on generic sampling distributions. To this end, we propose $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, which incorporates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models and couples the learned models with prior-guided action planning. Specifically, during learning, we incorporate a shared causal temporal module that aggregates temporal context within observation and prediction sequences under physical state supervision, grounding both in task-relevant physical states. When planning, we further introduce action inference through stepwise conditioning of a generative action distribution on the current and goal latent representations together with their evolving discrepancy, yielding anchored proposals that guide model-based online refinement. Together, physical state supervision guides temporal representation learning, while the action prior guides search through the learned world model. Experiments demonstrate improved planning performance on manipulation tasks, including tasks with increasing temporal separation between initial and goal observations. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/myl11045/G-JEPA.

analysis.key_results: 在操作任务上展现出改进的规划性能，包括初始与目标观测之间时间分离增大的任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出G-JEPA，将时间上下文聚合引入物理接地，并将先验引导的动作规划与潜在世界模型耦合。
analysis.method: 在JEPA框架中加入共享因果时间模块，在物理状态监督下聚合观察和预测序列中的时间上下文；规划时通过生成动作分布以当前和目标潜在表示及其演化的差异为条件，生成锚定提议来引导基于模型的在线细化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出G-JEPA，通过在JEPA框架中显式聚合时间上下文进行物理状态监督，并引入先验引导的动作规划来提升操作任务中的规划性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接致力于构建动作条件世界模型（WAM），通过改进潜在动力学建模和规划，对机器人操作任务中的世界建模具有核心价值。

figures.caption: Overview of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} -JEPA. World-model learning combines latent matching and SIGReg with (a) nuisance invariance under photometric augmentation and (b) temporal physical grounding. A shared S4D module aggregates temporal context separately within observed latents and aligned one-step predictions, supervising physical state estimates from both sequences. (c) During planning, the learned action prior is instantiated as a latent-conditioned diffusion policy that generates action proposals alongside Gaussian candidates. The frozen world model scores both sources using latent goal-matching costs, and a shared elite set updates the Gaussian search distribution. The policy remains fixed, while action execution provides new observations for subsequent planning rounds.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models
papers.title_zh: 探索潜在世界模型中时间上下文感知的物理接地

papers.abstract: Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than $1000\times$ and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.

analysis.key_results: 在单个 GPU 上 3 小时内超越基线（7 天 / 128 GPU）的回报；GPU 小时减少超过 1000 倍；129,514 个基准动作中仅 25 个失败（基线 179 个）；9.8 小时 / 2 GPU 实现零失败；世界模型预测误差在 1 到 264 小时动作时长内保持稳定；GPU 小时对目标回报的增长缓慢；策略迁移至实体 Unitree G1 完成多样杂技动作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SuperMimic 框架，使用单一可微分世界模型摊销跨动作学习，实现高效的人形全身控制扩展。
analysis.method: 从标准刚体模拟器的 logged transitions 拟合共享动力学世界模型，世界模型与追踪策略在同一个训练循环中训练，通过 short imagined rollouts 的时间反传提供解析梯度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SuperMimic 通过单一可微分世界模型与追踪策略联合训练，利用时间反传和想象 rollout 大幅度降低人形全身运动追踪的计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对机器人全身控制中的世界模型（WAM）应用，通过可微分世界模型与策略联合训练实现高效动作学习，且结果包括实体机器人迁移，对 WAM 主题有高度相关性。

papers.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.title_zh: SuperMimic：用单一可微分世界模型扩展人形全身控制

papers.abstract: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.

analysis.key_results: 在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D数据集上，平均成功率提高3.6个百分点，按路径长度加权的成功率提高2.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CLOSER框架，将停止决策视为闭环证据获取过程，结合VLM验证和主动感知，提升ObjectNav系统性能。
analysis.method: 微调开源VLM对候选目标的多视角进行分类（目标/非目标/不确定），使用嵌入多样性门控选择互补视角，通过轻量网络融合逐视角概率；若不确定，则利用扩散策略仅基于跟踪掩码和深度驱动智能体接近候选目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CLOSER是一个证据感知的主动验证框架，通过视觉-语言模型和主动感知对候选目标进行闭环验证，提高具身目标导航的任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作与VLA相关，因为它利用视觉-语言模型进行目标验证，并结合策略学习进行主动感知，以改进具身导航系统的决策可靠性，但其核心不是世界模型或动作预测世界建模。

figures.caption: With CLOSER, the agent approaches an uncertain candidate and decides from closer views. Given the goal bed , the view at (1) shows a distant, partially occluded candidate and does not suffice for a decision. CLOSER therefore labels the candidate uncertain , and the agent approaches it to gather additional views (orange, dotted). At (2), the closer view reveals a sofa confuser; CLOSER labels it no , and the agent resumes exploration (blue, solid). At (3), the view of the next candidate suffices; CLOSER labels it yes , and the agent moves to the bed and stops near it. The bottom panels show the agent’s view and CLOSER’s label at each numbered location.

papers.abstract: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8\% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31\% to 99\%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.

analysis.key_results: 在五个 UniVTAC 任务上平均成功率为 93.8%，与最先进策略性能相当，部分任务成功率更高；在插入孔任务中，触觉反馈将成功率从 31% 提升至 99%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy，将专家演示总结为任务指导和触觉参考，用于接触评估和纠正动作，避免机器人专用预训练和逐任务策略微调。
analysis.method: 利用 GPT-6-Astra 结合多模态观测和交互历史生成控制命令，并通过接触反馈调整动作；专家演示被总结为任务指导和触觉参考。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 GPT-as-Tactile-Policy 方法，将专家演示总结为任务指导和触觉参考，使通用多模态模型无需机器人专用预训练或微调即可进行接触丰富的操控任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略，实现通用多模态模型在接触丰富操控任务中的动作生成，与 VLA 主题高度相关，为机器人策略学习提供了新的基于大模型的方法。

papers.abstract: In speculative decoding, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies in parallel, speeding up generation without changing the target distribution. D-PACE (Wu et al., 2026) trains such drafters with a loss that weights each position by its contribution to the expected accepted length. Both its weights and its cross-entropy (CE) loss use only the draft's probability of the recorded target token, treating the target as a point mass. Under rejection sampling, however, a sampled draft token is accepted with probability equal to the overlap of the draft and target distributions, one minus their total variation (TV). We derive D-PAL (Dynamic Position-wise Acceptance Loss) from the exact expected accepted length, using this overlap as the acceptance signal. This yields overlap-based position weights with log acceptance (LA) as the per-position loss, and the objective reduces to D-PACE for a point-mass target. Since the weights are detached, any per-position loss can replace LA in practice. We show that forward KL divergence and R\'enyi divergence of order 1/2 match or exceed LA, and that R\'enyi-1/2 provably bounds the true acceptance rate from above and below. Replacing CE with R\'enyi-1/2 improves acceptance length under both D-PACE's weights and ours. On six benchmarks with a Qwen3-4B target, D-PAL raises mean acceptance length over D-PACE from 4.50 to 4.57 at T=0 and from 4.20 to 4.28 at T=1, and consistently achieves higher throughput at both temperatures.

analysis.key_results: 在六个基准测试上，以Qwen3-4B为目标模型，D-PAL将平均接受长度从D-PACE的4.50提高到4.57（T=0），从4.20提高到4.28（T=1），并在两种温度下获得更高吞吐量。
analysis.main_contribution: 推导并提出了D-PAL（Dynamic Position-wise Acceptance Loss），将接受信号从草稿与目标分布的重叠（1-TV）出发，得到基于接受度的位置权重和LA损失，并证明Rényi-1/2散度能上下界真实接受率，且提升接受长度。
analysis.method: 基于精确期望接受长度推导位置权重，使用分布重叠作为接受信号，以对数接受度（LA）为每位置损失；权重被detach，实践中可替换任意每位置损失（如forward KL和Rényi-1/2）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出D-PAL，利用精确期望接受长度推导基于接受度的位置权重和分布损失，以改进推测解码的草稿模型训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于推测解码这一独立的高效推理技术，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但其方法可泛化用于任何自回归模型的快速生成，包括未来可能用于机器人模型的加速推理，因此对本站关注的效率优化主题具有参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond the Point Mass: Acceptance-Derived Weights and Distributional Losses for Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: 超越点质量：基于接受度的权重与分布损失用于推测解码

papers.abstract: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: GPT-6 Astra在RoboDojo上获得26.92%成功率，RoboTwin 2.0上获得76.0%，在LIBERO-GeoMotion上零样本成功率为11.1%；真实世界实验显示简单任务可零样本执行，但运动可行性、精确控制和物理安全仍存在缺陷，且推理延迟大。
analysis.limitations: 模型在后果感知动作规划、精确性和复杂运动协调方面存在明显差距；推理延迟阻碍实际部署。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统评估通用多模态模型GPT-6 Astra的具身能力，并引入新基准LIBERO-GeoMotion来揭示空间理解到物理可行运动的转化困难。
analysis.method: 通过轻量级智能体执行框架进行能力探测和五个现有操作基准的六维评估，并在新基准LIBERO-GeoMotion和真实世界实验中验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文系统评估了GPT-6 Astra在闭环机器人操作中的表现，揭示了语义推理与物理执行之间的显著差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA主题高度相关，因为论文直接评估大型多模态模型作为视觉-语言-动作策略在机器人操作中的表现，并系统分析其具身能力与不足。

papers.abstract: Large language models can solve complex problems across a variety of subjects, such as mathematics and coding. For such complex analytical tasks, models with a long context perform better. Serving models with long context is currently mostly done on powerful systems with multiple GPUs, which are too expensive for most users. An alternative is local inference, or serving a model on a user's own machine, which removes per-token costs and rate limits, besides keeping sensitive data private and giving users full control over the models they run. The common understanding, however, is that local LLMs need compression (e.g., quantization) to run on a single GPU. In this paper, we set out to study the limitations that prevent serving long-context models for single users, besides the capacity issue. Rather than characterizing a single model on one GPU, we analyze how different models behave across several GPU generations. This lets us uncover not just individual bottlenecks but broader trends in where inefficiencies arise. Our analysis confirms that, as expected, self-attention dominates the runtime for long-context inference. More unexpectedly, our evaluation reveals that the current structure of self-attention leaves key GPU resources significantly underutilized, and the newest GPU is often the least well served. Many of these findings are fundamentally data management problems, from paging the KV cache to improving cache utilization and synchronization in the GPU, which is why we bring this study to the Data Systems community. To engage this community, we present our findings as a series of experimental observations and formulate recommendations for future work.

analysis.key_results: 自注意力在长上下文推理中占主导运行时间；当前自注意力结构使关键GPU资源显著未充分利用；最新GPU通常最受影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过跨多代GPU的实验分析，揭示长上下文LLM本地推理中除容量外的主要瓶颈，并指出自注意力机制导致关键GPU资源利用不足，且最新GPU往往最受影响。
analysis.method: 跨不同GPU代际对多个模型进行长上下文推理性能实验，分析自注意力、KV缓存分页、缓存利用和同步等数据管理问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 从数据系统角度研究长上下文LLM在本地单GPU上做推理时的性能瓶颈，重点关注内存管理与GPU资源利用不足。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型，但其对长上下文推理和量化/高效推理的研究可间接为机器人策略或视觉-语言-动作模型的本地部署提供方法参考。

papers.title: Local Inference of LLMs on Long Contexts: A Data Systems Perspective
papers.title_zh: 长上下文大语言模型本地推理的数据系统视角研究

papers.abstract: Reasoning-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) driving models can perceive and reason about safety-critical hazards yet fail to translate that evidence into safe actions. We characterize this failure as a perception-action binding gap: hazard information is available inside the model but exerts insufficient control over trajectory generation. Using matched simulated counterfactuals and logged driving replay, we show that in-path hazards are actually encoded in the visual representation, but longitudinal plans are dominated by ego-speed history and respond only weakly to hazard proximity or the model's own reasoning trace. Further analysis shows that the trajectory generator is capable of braking but sometimes fails to do so due to the perception-action binding gap. Without retraining or modifying any weights, we inject a hazard-conditioned energy into the frozen flow-matching sampler of Alpamayo-1.5, restoring the missing coupling at generation time. With exact obstacle geometry, guidance cuts footprint intrusion from 58.1% to 14.5% and recovers safe braking whenever sufficient stopping distance remains, eliminating collisions entirely in our braking-relevant closed-loop battery. It also reverses the diagnosed dependence of the plan, from tracking ego speed to responding to obstacle range. These results separate hazard perception from hazard control in driving VLAs, show that unsafe behavior can arise even when the model has both the evidence and the ability to act on it, and propose a simple fix for bridging this binding gap.

analysis.key_results: 精确障碍物几何信息下，足迹侵入率从58.1%降至14.5%，在制动相关闭环测试中消除了碰撞，并逆转了规划对自身速度历史的依赖。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别并修复推理驾驶VLA中的感知-动作绑定缺口，通过注入危险条件能量到冻结的流匹配采样器中，提升安全驾驶行为。
analysis.method: 在冻结的流匹配采样器中注入危险条件能量，无需重训练或修改模型权重，以恢复感知与动作之间的耦合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文揭示推理增强的驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型存在感知-动作绑定缺口，并利用生成时引导无需重训练地修复安全驾驶行为。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究VLA模型在驾驶任务中的感知-动作耦合问题，属于VLA核心主题，对机器人学习与安全控制具有直接价值。

Binding gap: visual hazard evidence and the model’s reasoning trace have substantially weaker authority over the longitudinal plan than ego history. Intervention: a hazard-conditioned energy gradient is added during flow integration, steering the frozen trajectory generator toward a safe plan without modifying model weights.

papers.title: Perceives but Doesn't Brake: A Perception-Action Binding Gap in Reasoning Driving VLAs
papers.title_zh: 感知却不刹车：推理驾驶VLA中的感知-动作绑定缺口

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly reason before acting, but existing reasoning models compress this intermediate decision into a single representation. When several plans are valid, this commitment hides alternatives that could otherwise be selected or revised. We introduce the Generative Plan Latent (GPL), which represents the reasoning state as a low-dimensional conditional distribution over plans, such as which object, grasp, or route to use. This makes the reasoning state addressable: without retraining the VLA, plans can be sampled (coverage), selected on request (steering), and reweighted by deployment outcomes (outcome adaptation). We test all three on SimplerEnv manipulation with $\pi_0$, and extend the analysis to RoboCasa, LIBERO, and a maze domain. Steering the plan raises the fraction of executions that follow the request from 0.48 to 0.94, while the same guidance on the native action distribution shows no reliable gain. Finally, we show that an explicit plan is most useful when it carries decision information not already determined by the observation.

analysis.key_results: 在SimplerEnv操作任务中，将执行遵循请求的比例从0.48提升至0.94；对原生动作分布的相同引导无可靠增益；并扩展至RoboCasa、LIBERO和迷宫环境。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入生成式计划潜变量（GPL），使VLA的中间推理状态成为可寻址的计划分布，并展示了其在覆盖、引导和结果自适应方面的能力。
analysis.method: 生成式计划潜变量（GPL），将推理状态表示为计划（如物体、抓取方式或路径）的低维条件分布，并在采样、引导和结果自适应任务中测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出生成式计划潜变量，将VLA的推理状态表示为计划上的低维条件分布，使计划无需重训即可被采样、选择与结果自适应调整。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文以视觉-语言-动作模型为核心，改进其推理与计划表示，使其可覆盖、引导和依据结果自适应，对VLA策略的灵活性与可控性有直接贡献。

figures.caption: The distribution should live at the decision bottleneck. When several plans are valid, a committed regression readout can lie between them; gpl preserves the alternatives at the plan level, where they can be sampled, guided, or reweighted before execution.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Reasoning as a Distribution: Generative Plan Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: 以分布形式推理：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的生成式计划潜变量

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on standard robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their reliability can degrade substantially when task conditions deviate from the nominal setting. Perturbations in object positions and task instructions may lead to complete task failure. Existing VLA policies generally lack an explicit runtime mechanism for distinguishing these failure modes and selecting an appropriate recovery strategy. To systematically mitigate this issue, we propose FIT-MAC, a failure-aware, closed-loop multi-agent control framework for improving the robustness of VLA policies at inference time. FIT-MAC augments a VLA policy with an inference-time control layer. First, the Planner Agent parses the language instruction into a structured task specification that captures the manipulation goal and spatial constraints, and the Grounder Agent resolves each instruction-level reference to a visual target. Next, the Verifier Agent tracks phase-specific execution progress, distinguishes target-binding errors from local execution failures, and determines whether intervention is warranted. The Correction Agent then routes permitted interventions to target rebinding or bounded grasping or placement recovery, depending on the failure type. When no intervention is required, the pretrained VLA remains the default action generator. Extensive experiments on LIBERO-PRO demonstrate that FIT-MAC improves robustness across multiple VLA backbones, consistently increasing success rates and achieving state-of-the-art performance under diverse perturbations.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-PRO上的大量实验表明，FIT-MAC在多个VLA骨干网络上持续提高成功率，并在多种扰动下达到最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FIT-MAC，一种故障感知的闭环多智能体控制框架，通过在推理时对VLA策略增加控制层来系统性地缓解分布偏移下的任务失败。
analysis.method: 框架包含Planner Agent将指令解析为结构化任务规范，Grounder Agent将指令级引用解析为视觉目标，Verifier Agent跟踪执行进度并区分目标绑定错误与局部执行失败，Correction Agent根据失败类型路由到目标重新绑定或有界抓取/放置恢复；无干预时使用预训练VLA。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个故障感知的闭环多智能体框架FIT-MAC，在推理时通过规划、接地、验证和纠正四个代理提高VLA策略在扰动下的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型在分布偏移下的可靠性问题，通过推理时闭环多智能体控制框架提升机器人操作鲁棒性，与VLA主题高度相关。

papers.title: FIT-MAC: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: FIT-MAC：面向鲁棒视觉-语言-动作模型的闭环多智能体框架

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly deployed with asynchronous inference in real-world settings, where the next action chunk is generated while the robot is still executing the previous one. By the time the new chunk is committed, the robot and scene have changed, so the chunk is conditioned on a stale observation and task success drops sharply as this inference delay grows. Generating multiple candidate chunks could let newer observations inform the final choice, but existing multi-candidate methods either rank candidates with the stale inference-start observation or repeatedly switch between candidates during execution, which can make the executed action sequence discontinuous. Our key insight is that inference delay can be used as decision time. While candidate generation is still underway, candidate selection can reuse the VLA itself to choose the complete action chunk that best fits a later observation. We propose PACT-VLA, a training-free framework that generates candidates from the inference-start observation and selects one using this pre-commit observation. Its scoring function, FlowRes, measures the residual between each candidate's implied flow direction and the velocity predicted by the frozen policy under the pre-commit observation, requiring no separate verifier. A pipelined implementation overlaps observation processing with candidate generation and batches scoring, so selection adds no control-step delay on the evaluated hardware. At a four-step delay, PACT-VLA improves average success by 15.0 percentage points over RTC on Kinetix and by 5.2 points over single-candidate asynchronous execution with GR00T N1.7 on LIBERO, and it further improves existing delay-robust methods. On three real-robot tasks, it raises average success from 60% to 82% over naive asynchronous execution with the same frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint.

analysis.key_results: 在四步延迟下，PACT-VLA 在 Kinetix 上平均成功率比 RTC 高 15.0 个百分点，在 LIBERO 上比单候选异步执行（GR00T N1.7）高 5.2 个百分点；三个真实机器人任务平均成功率从 60% 提高到 82%（与同一冻结 π0.5 检查点的朴素异步执行相比）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练无关框架 PACT-VLA，生成多个候选动作块并用预提交观测选择最佳块，引入 FlowRes 评分函数无需独立验证器，且流水线实现不增加控制步延迟。
analysis.method: 从推理开始观测生成候选动作块，使用预提交观测通过冻结 VLA 策略的 FlowRes 残差评分选择最佳候选，流水线重叠观测处理与候选生成并批量评分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PACT-VLA 利用推断延迟作为决策时间，通过在选择时用 VLA 自身对预提交观测下的多个候选动作块进行评分，提高异步推理下 VLA 策略的任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对 VLA 策略在异步推理下的延迟鲁棒性问题，通过推测性动作块生成与验证提高效率与成功率，对 VLA 和机器人动作预测具有直接价值。

Before the planned chunk switch at t + d t+d , the pre-commit observation o t + d − 1 o_{t+d-1} is used to evaluate the fixed candidates with FlowRes. papers.abstract: A planner using a learned world model can improve its predicted outcome while choosing a worse action. We study when expected free energy (EFE) can help decide how much computation to spend on a plan. An EFE-inspired objective combines goal distance with disagreement among stochastic predictions. We test candidate scoring, stopping, and online predictor updates separately. Stopping when elite cost stalls reduces refinement on tasks whose success plateaus with depth, with mean success close to fixed-depth references. At the larger tested weights, rewarding disagreement lowers success with a frozen model. Penalizing it helps at some task and weight settings but harms others. When training data omit a region needed to reach the goal, online updates recover part of the resulting loss. The tested cost-stall rule can fail when further optimization exploits model errors, because predicted cost keeps falling after task success peaks. Cost progress can guide computation on a plateau, but protecting performance after a peak requires information about the consequences of the chosen actions.

analysis.key_results: 停止准则在精英成本停滞时能减少优化，平均成功率接近固定深度参考；在较大权重下奖励不一致性会降低成功率，惩罚不一致性在某些任务和权重设置下有益；在线更新可恢复部分因训练数据缺失导致的性能损失；成本停滞准则可能因模型错误而在真实任务成功率下降后仍持续优化。
analysis.limitations: 成本停滞规则可能失败，因为进一步优化会利用模型错误，导致预测成本持续下降但任务成功率已见顶；需要关于动作后果的信息来保护性能峰值后的表现。
analysis.main_contribution: 将期望自由能启发式目标（结合目标距离与随机预测不一致性）作为测试时计算控制器，系统剖析其在潜在世界模型规划中的作用与局限。
analysis.method: 提出EFE启发式目标，分别测试候选评分、精英成本停滞停止准则和在线预测更新，并在多任务上评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了在基于学习世界模型的规划中，使用期望自由能（EFE）启发的目标来决定投入多少计算量，并分别测试了候选评分、停止准则和在线预测更新。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究世界模型规划中的测试时计算控制，虽未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作世界模型，但其对世界模型规划效率和可靠性分析可为本站在世界模型和机器人学习方向的方法论提供参考。

papers.abstract: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot

analysis.key_results: 在多个移动操作任务上评估了接口，并在物理机器人上微调MolmoAct2后成功部署，验证了完整的采集-部署流水线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个统一的机器人参与式数据采集与策略部署框架，无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学，实现从演示到执行的端到端流水线。
analysis.method: 利用第二台机械臂作为领导者设备，结合两个手持控制器和被动性约束的触觉通道，实现对基座、躯干、机械臂和夹爪的同步控制；通过ROS 2记录同步多模态观测和统一的11维动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LocoPilot，一个在四足机器人上实现单人双边遥操作的数据采集与部署一体化框架，用于学习移动操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接服务于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习，通过提供与部署一致的动作接口和同步多模态观测数据，实现机器人移动操作策略的端到端训练与部署，对VLA主题具有核心价值。

papers.abstract: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

analysis.key_results: 在构造的多模态任务和D3IL基准上学习到不同延续，生成多条障碍跨越路径；相比变分基线提升预测有效性和分布保真度；展示了量子先验的参数高效采样结构和在真实QPU上的推理可行性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Quantum-JEPA框架，用条件量子Born先验生成潜在动作并映射到多种未来表示，以参数高效的方式对多模态未来分布建模。
analysis.method: 在JEPA框架中引入量子Born先验，电路测量生成二元潜在动作，通过共享预测器映射到未来表示，并用采样能量目标训练先验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Quantum-JEPA，一种用条件量子Born先验学习未来表示分布的潜在动作JEPA框架，以提升世界模型中的不确定性建模。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文属于世界模型范畴，与本站主题直接相关，但主要贡献是量子Born先验在JEPA中的应用，未涉及VLA或机器人动作生成，属于世界建模研究，对机器人领域有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: History-dependent robotic manipulation requires task context and interaction history, as the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the next action. Hierarchical frameworks use task memory for high-level subgoal reasoning and low-level policies for execution. However, memory updates require accurate completion assessment: similar observations may correspond to different execution phases, and prematurely recording completion can mislead subsequent subgoal reasoning. We present EventSync, a hierarchical framework that coordinates task reasoning and action execution through event-driven memory updates. A vision-language model generates subgoals from task plans and interaction history, while a vision-language-action model executes them. A lightweight Event Monitor combines visual observations with end-effector trajectories to determine whether the current subgoal is complete. The framework records the current subgoal in its completed-subgoal history and triggers subsequent reasoning only after obtaining completion evidence. With visual history in the executor, EventSync achieves 64.5% overall success on RoboMME, exceeding the best baseline reported in the benchmark by 20.0 percentage points. Further analysis shows that this update mechanism helps build a reliable completed-subgoal history. Experiments on four real-robot tasks with different memory requirements validate the framework's effectiveness in real-world robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME基准上达到64.5%总体成功率，比该基准报告的最佳基线高出20.0个百分点；在四个具有不同记忆需求的真实机器人任务上验证了有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EventSync分层框架，通过事件驱动的记忆更新机制协调高层子目标推理与低层执行，避免错误记录子目标完成，提升任务成功率。
analysis.method: 使用视觉语言模型生成子目标，视觉语言动作模型执行动作，轻量级事件监视器结合视觉观察和末端执行器轨迹判断子目标完成，仅在获得完成证据后更新历史并触发后续推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EventSync提出一种分层框架，通过事件驱动的记忆更新协调任务推理与动作执行，以处理历史相关的机器人操作任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接关注VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出通过事件驱动的记忆更新提升历史相关任务的策略性能，对VLA/机器人策略学习具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Real-world observations are noisy and often contain excessive task-irrelevant information. Effective world modeling and planning need to abstract observations into world state representations while filtering out irrelevant information. However, encoders in existing world models are typically non-adaptive, leading to state representations that are easily distracted by task-irrelevant information. As a result, the model may not selectively filter observations to cater to different task demands. To address this problem, we introduce ConfigWM, which realizes configurable perception through task-conditioned state extraction. Given a language description of the task at hand, ConfigWM uses it as a configuration signal to steer how visual embeddings are mapped into a task-specific state space, selectively preserving information relevant to the current task while suppressing task-irrelevant variations. Action-conditioned dynamics are then learned in this task-specific state space for planning. We evaluate ConfigWM in environments with increasing levels of distraction. While existing methods exhibit substantial declines in planning success rate as the environments become increasingly noisy, ConfigWM remains comparatively stable and outperforms the strongest competing method by 22.3% on average across diverse environments. Consistent gains in physical-quantity probing (+0.365 Pearson r) and distracted-to-clean retrieval (+75.5%) further indicate that ConfigWM learns states that preserve task-relevant information while remaining robust to distractors, supporting reliable world modeling and planning in noisy worlds. Project Page: https://configwm.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在不同干扰程度的环境中，ConfigWM相比最强竞争方法在规划成功率上平均提升22.3%，物理量探测Pearson相关系数提升+0.365，干扰到干净检索性能提升+75.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ConfigWM，一种利用任务语言描述作为配置信号、自适应提取与任务相关状态表示的视觉世界模型，实现对干扰信息的抑制。
analysis.method: 使用语言描述作为配置信号，引导视觉嵌入映射到任务特定状态空间，并在此空间中学习动作条件动态模型进行规划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ConfigWM通过任务语言描述配置感知过程，在任务特定状态空间中学习动作条件动态，以提升嘈杂环境下的规划鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于世界模型中视觉状态提取的任务相关性，属于世界模型（WAM）相关研究，但未涉及机器人动作预测或VLA，与本站主题有部分关联。
