papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $\pi_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

analysis.key_results: $\pi_{0.5}$在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下均比Octo获得更高任务性能得分，且退化更小；本体感知信息对策略性能有影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个结合MuJoCo仿真环境、遥操作演示收集和预训练通用策略（Octo和$\pi_{0.5}$）适应的仿真到现实框架，用于农业抓取任务。
analysis.method: 利用MuJoCo构建多样番茄植株仿真环境，通过操纵杆遥操作收集专家演示，使用低层控制器执行动作，并用仿真和真实机器人演示对预训练VLA策略进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一个仿真到现实的机器人学习框架，通过任务特定演示收集和预训练策略适应来实现农业场景中的抓取操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心涉及预训练VLA策略在农业机器人操作任务中的适应，属于VLA在真实机器人操作中的应用研究，与本站点VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

analysis.key_results: 在Snapdragon 8 Elite上，与llama.cpp最快的NPU配置相比，Tandem将基于文本的屏幕描述的每步延迟降低30%，截图场景降低16%，文本步骤能耗降低33%，并将在模型加载时的待机功耗从0.76W降低到0.22W。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Tandem运行时，用于在移动NPU上高效服务混合线性注意力GUI代理，通过及时的循环状态保存、矩阵单元上的预填充和逐令牌回滚状态生成来降低每步延迟和能耗。
analysis.method: Tandem保存连续提示分歧处的循环状态以重用已处理的上下文；将大部分预填充保持在矩阵单元上，并通过短的逐令牌尾部生成回滚状态；验证内核为所有提议的令牌只读取一次权重块；在请求突发之间释放NPU功率投票而不卸载模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Tandem是一个针对混合线性注意力GUI代理的移动NPU运行时，通过重用循环状态和优化自适应解码来降低延迟和能耗。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于移动NPU上的高效GUI代理推理，属于投机解码和高效推理范畴，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界建模。

figures.caption: Workload-driven serving challenges for mobile GUI agents. Each step observes the screen and generates an action. (a) Consecutive prompts share a prefix but diverge in recent history or screen content, making chat-oriented checkpoints poorly placed. (b) Short outputs provide few opportunities to amortize the prefill overhead of speculative rollback states. Tandem retains matrix-based prefill and uses a short recurrent tail. (c) Between tasks, active NPU power requests can waste energy even when the model remains idle. Tandem releases these requests without unloading the model.

papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在六项真实世界任务上，显著提升了现有人形机器人移动操作模型的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HAF-VLA，一种分层动作流框架，用于将通用VLA策略适配到人形机器人移动操作，包括可学习阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存条件化机制，以在共享全身动作空间中分阶段生成动作。
analysis.method: 基于预训练流匹配VLA，继承视觉语言前缀编码器和动作专家权重；采用层级式阶段去噪（先移动与头部命令，再腰部细化，最后全身操作），并引入跨阶段KV缓存条件化以保持阶段间结构依赖性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HAF-VLA框架，将预训练流匹配VLA适配到人形机器人全身移动操作，通过分阶段动作去噪和跨阶段KV缓存条件化解决高维全身动作生成中的稳定性与协调问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA高度相关：论文直接针对人形机器人的视觉-语言-动作策略适配，涉及全身动作空间的分层生成与控制，属于机器人动作预测与策略学习的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

analysis.key_results: 在采样温度T=0时，在Gemma 4-12B上平均接受长度提升19.4%，解码速度提升17.9%（八个基准）；在四个目标模型和八个基准上平均接受长度提升15.2%，解码速度提升13.4%（使用预训练DFlash草稿器）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用验证器在前一个草稿块中被拒绝位置后的隐藏状态，将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在移位位置，并行生成多个草稿块，从而改进预测并延长草稿范围。
analysis.method: 在扩散草稿器的基础上，利用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态作为锚点，将草稿器重新锚定在移位位置；并行生成额外草稿块，扩展原始块内预测和块外覆盖；无需训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在不同位置，并行生成草稿块以提升接受长度和解码速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究独立的推测解码效率优化，与VLA/WAM或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但其方法可潜在地加速任何基于自回归解码的模型，包括VLA或WAM中的语言/动作解码器。

papers.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting

papers.abstract: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

analysis.key_results: 在受控消融集上，ScopeMem 将正确决策被破坏的比例降至 5.6%，同时修复的错误数量优于所有 CE 训练前缀；在 AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey 和零样本 AITW 上超越所有评估的提示和潜在记忆基线，使冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到或超过 GUI 专用智能体和 Qwen3-VL-32B 的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ScopeMem，一种学习修订范围的潜在记忆方法，其编码器根据模型初始答案生成前缀，训练时纠正错误同时保留正确决策，解决了 CE 训练前缀因无范围修订而破坏正确动作的问题。
analysis.method: ScopeMem 编码器以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀；训练目标是在修正错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ScopeMem 提出一种潜在记忆方法，通过控制前缀生成范围，在修正冻结视觉语言模型（GUI 智能体）的错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于 GUI 智能体的潜在记忆与高效推理，不直接涉及机器人或世界模型。但其核心思想——在冻结视觉语言模型中学习何时修订输出，保留正确预测——对 VLA（视觉语言动作模型）的高效推理和策略修正具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $\pi_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.

analysis.key_results: 将语言主干从2.34B压缩到0.09B，完整模型从3.37B压缩到1.12B；在四个LIBERO套件上平均成功率从84.55%提升到93.45%，推理速度提升1.98倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SPAR方法，对VLA模型π0.5进行结构剪枝和剪枝感知微调，并利用强化学习恢复策略性能，实现了大幅参数压缩和推理加速，同时提高了任务成功率。
analysis.method: 结构剪枝与动作恢复（SPAR）：对LLM主干的隐藏维度和前馈中间维度进行剪枝，剪枝感知微调，随后使用强化学习恢复策略性能。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SPAR通过结构剪枝和强化学习在保持操纵性能的同时大幅压缩VLA模型并提升推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的压缩与高效推理，属于机器人策略学习和高效推理的交叉领域，对部署高效VLA系统具有重要价值。

figures.caption: Overview of the SPAR Framework. Top: SPAR compresses the LLM backbone of a VLA policy, which integrates visual and language inputs to guide the action expert. Bottom: (1) Through pruning-aware tuning , SPAR jointly learns channel masks for the hidden dimension and the FFN intermediate dimension while adapting the policy to manipulation tasks. (2) These masks guide structural pruning , which removes inactive channels to form a smaller dense backbone. (3) After supervised fine-tuning of the compact policy, RL recovery further improves task performance through simulated interaction, updating the action expert and value head while keeping the pruned LLM backbone frozen.

papers.title: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: SPAR：视觉-语言-动作模型的结构剪枝与动作恢复

papers.abstract: Human-collected robot manipulation data often mix successful behavior with retries, pauses, recoveries, and failures. Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning (AC-BC) can exploit such mixed-quality data, but only if the conditioning signal is both accurately constructed from offline trajectories and effectively incorporated into the policy's action-vector-field prediction. Existing pipelines can weaken this signal by thresholding estimator-derived advantage scores into noisy conditions, and by routing conditions through prompts that weakly affect the action vector field. We introduce ALIGN, a condition-aligned AC-BC framework for vision-language-action policies. ALIGN directly predicts categorical pairwise conditions in the policy-facing label space and injects them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation fused with flow time. We evaluate ALIGN on deliberately mixed real-robot datasets for ARX X5 bowl stacking and Franka key hanging, each combining standard demonstrations with retry-heavy trajectories. ALIGN improves condition fidelity, strengthens conditional vector-field separability, and achieves 90.0% and 56.7% closed-loop success, compared with 56.7% and 33.3% for the strongest AC-BC baseline. These results indicate that aligning conditions from estimation to action prediction is an effective way to extract robust manipulation policies from data in which success, recovery and error coexist.

analysis.key_results: 在 ARX X5 碗堆叠和 Franka 钥匙悬挂真实机器人数据集上，ALIGN 分别达到 90.0% 和 56.7% 闭环成功率，优于最强 AC-BC 基线的 56.7% 和 33.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ALIGN 框架，将优势条件行为克隆的条件信号从估计到动作预测进行对齐，提高混合质量数据下的操作策略稳健性。
analysis.method: 直接预测策略标签空间中的分类成对条件，并通过 AdaRMS 调制与流动时间融合注入 DiT 动作专家。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ALIGN 提出一种条件对齐的视觉-语言-动作策略，通过直接预测分类成对条件并注入 DiT 动作专家，更好地利用混合质量机器人数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作策略的条件对齐，属于 VLA 核心研究，利用混合质量机器人数据提升操作策略学习。

figures.caption: Overview of ALIGN. Left: condition estimation. Given a historical observation, the current observation, robot states, and the task instruction, the direct categorical estimator predicts the AC-BC condition c ^ t \hat{c}_{t} from an ordered observation pair. Right: AC-BC policy training with estimated conditions. The current observation stream is encoded by the VLM, while AdaRMS combines c ^ t \hat{c}_{t} with the flow-time embedding to generate per-layer modulation parameters for the DiT action expert, so the predicted action vector field is explicitly conditioned on the estimated training condition.

papers.abstract: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

analysis.key_results: 在VideoXum和MixTyVSum基准上，RVLSM在多个模型设置和指标上优于零样本VideoLLM基线，并与最先进的微调模型竞争；RVLSM摘要中的命名实体与基准摘要的对齐更紧密。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出递归视频语言摘要模型（RVLSM），通过语义时间分解（STD）和自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）实现长视频摘要。
analysis.method: RVLSM递归分解视频为语义一致的片段，将块级推理委托给VideoLLM子模型和外部工具，采用STD动态分区视频并调用AMTC路由机制选择性调用辅助模块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出首个递归视频语言摘要模型，通过语义时间分解和自适应多模态工具调用，改进长视频到文本的摘要生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对长视频理解与摘要，属于视觉语言模型的高效推理，但不直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Every driving scene is logged once, but driving is one-to-many: the scene determines which behaviors are feasible, while an instruction selects among them. A log records only the action taken, leaving no direct supervision for alternative feasible actions or instructions the scene cannot support. Consequently, a policy that ignores language and one that follows it without regard to scene constraints can fit the same data. We present Cartender, which learns from the drives not taken. Counterfactual Branching constructs matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real recordings without a simulator: a vision-language model proposes alternative futures and their selecting instructions, while unsupported instructions provide negative labels. A learned scene-language compatibility score regulates language conditioning in trajectory generation, and a reward-trained language residual re-ranks generated candidates over a scene-based score. The branches are used for training; instruction following is evaluated by swapping instructions under identical recorded inputs and measuring behavior rather than agreement with generated targets. On WOD-E2E, the best of four proposals achieves an RFS of 8.642 across 3,603 feasible instruction conditions. Across 8,974 admitted proposals, mean RFS is 8.203 versus 7.906 for matched logged trajectories, and 67% score higher than their logged counterpart. Compared with matched-only imitation using the same backbone, Cartender improves same-scene paired instruction success from 23.67% to 57.00% and RFS from 6.32 to 7.10; its gate reduces infeasible-instruction execution from 53.36% to 14.18%.

analysis.key_results: 在WOD-E2E上，四个提案中最佳RFS为8.642（3603个可行指令条件）；89874个已接收提案平均RFS为8.203对比匹配记录轨迹的7.906；67%得分高于记录轨迹；同场景配对指令成功率从23.67%提升至57.00%，RFS从6.32提升至7.10；不可行指令执行率从53.36%降至14.18%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cartender方法，通过反事实分支从真实驾驶记录中学习未采取的驾驶行为，并引入场景-语言兼容性分数调节语言条件轨迹生成，以及奖励训练的语言残差重排序生成候选。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言模型提议替代未来及其选择指令，从不支持的指令获取负标签；训练场景-语言兼容性分数调节语言条件轨迹生成；利用奖励训练的语言残差在基于场景的分数上重排序候选。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Cartender利用真实驾驶记录中的反事实分支生成匹配与不匹配的指令-动作对，以学习场景-语言兼容性并提升语言条件驾驶策略的指令遵循能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文涉及语言条件驾驶策略的学习与评估，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驱动的机器人学习方向，但未明确涉及世界模型（WAM），与本站主题部分相关。

Compatibility modulates generation and a language-dependent ranking residual. After base initialization, reward learning updates only the residual. papers.abstract: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

analysis.key_results: 在板卡上量化后模型保持了优秀的分割性能，且在代表性测试平台上对端到端处理链和并行工作流进行了表征。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实现了一条通用的星载AI处理链，涵盖模型量化、场景级推理工作流以及基于unikernel和ORCHIDE的任务级编排，并通过野火分割、船舶检测和云分割三个应用进行了验证。
analysis.method: 将AI模型调优（波段选择、输入归一化）、量化为int8并移植到AMD Versal VCK190；使用模块化的分块-推理-拼接（tiler-inference-mosaicer）工作流将分块级模型扩展到整景；将每个步骤打包为unikernel并在ORCHIDE编排器下运行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一条通用的星载AI处理链，将模型量化到int8并部署在AMD Versal VCK190上，通过模块化分块-推理-拼接工作流和unikernel编排实现端到端场景级处理，并以野火分割等应用为例进行验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文不涉及VLA或WAM，主要关注星载AI处理链中的模型量化（int8）和高效部署/编排。虽然量化技术对VLA/WAM的低比特部署有方法学参考价值，但本文未与机器人动作预测或世界模型直接关联。

papers.abstract: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界实验表明，RoboPhoto-VLA能生成更符合人类美学偏好的照片，并有效泛化到未见主体、视角、姿态和复杂摄影指令。
analysis.main_contribution: RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，整合摄影意图理解、运动规划与美学优化。
analysis.method: PhotoCoT结构化动作规划与Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) 对齐人类美学偏好，并构建OpenPhotography数据集进行训练与评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，结合结构化动作规划和美学偏好对齐。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接提出并训练一个VLA模型用于机器人摄影任务，属于VLA在具身智能中的典型应用，与本站主题高度相关。

The system then detects the user, identifies incomplete framing of the pose, and initiates adjustments to its position and angle (upper right). Next, RoboPhoto-VLA precisely adjusts its robotic arm and camera orientation to align with the desired composition (lower left). The lower-right panel displays the final unretouched photograph captured by RoboPhoto-VLA.

The architecture follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with PhotoCoT for structured photographic grounding and multi-step action planning; (2) Reinforcement Learning (RL) with ADPO for refining action selection to better align with human aesthetic preferences.

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，使用 DAPO-Math-17k 训练，ASE 相比 GRPO 在六个数学推理基准上的平均 Mean@8 分别提升了 4.87 和 1.87 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 Activation-Space Exploration (ASE)，一种在线方法，通过聚类激活差异构建结构化潜在探索向量库，并应用到后续采样中以探索替代推理路径。
analysis.method: 在 RLVR 框架下，聚类同一问题正确与错误响应间的激活差异，构建潜在探索向量库，并将不同向量应用到后续采样中。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 ASE 方法，通过聚类正确与错误响应的激活差异构建探索向量库，以多样化强化学习中的采样路径，提升数学推理性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究语言模型在数学推理任务上的强化学习探索策略，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人学习，与本站主题无直接关系。

figures.caption: Motivation and high-level overview of activation-space exploration. Standard GRPO samples all responses from one proposal distribution, whereas ASE uses outcome feedback to maintain multiple activation-space directions, routes responses through different proposals, and updates the actor and vector bank online.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: ASE pipeline. We replay successful and unsuccessful responses to read out hidden activations, cluster their pairwise differences to form exploration directions, match and smooth the directions across updates, and inject one selected direction into the residual stream for each routed response.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

papers.abstract: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.

analysis.key_results: 在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上，比SHANKS风格窗口基线提高了聚合推测工具覆盖率或检索重用；在FDBench v3上工具覆盖率提高16个百分点，平均最终响应延迟降低36.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入心跳思维机制，在语音理解过程中周期性地对最新部分转录进行推理，同时允许已进行中的推理和工具调用完成，实现跨语音更新的推测准备。

papers.abstract: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

analysis.key_results: 在LifePhotoBench上，GeoEdit对6种主流MLRM实现了强大保护，在图像保真度上比视觉扰动基线高出0.59以上。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GeoEdit，一个对抗性去证据框架，通过图像编辑实现静默地理隐私保护，在保持图像可分享性的同时有效破坏MLRM的地理推理。
analysis.method: 结合结构化知识与对抗发现的地理线索识别高风险证据锚点，采用可学习策略迭代优化编辑决策，并将成功轨迹蒸馏为可迁移的自然语言见解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种对抗性图像编辑框架GeoEdit，通过最小编辑高风险证据锚点来破坏多模态大推理模型的地理推理链，从而保护隐私。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对多模态大推理模型的地理推理能力进行对抗性干扰，涉及视觉语言模型的空间推理，但不涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型训练；其对抗性编辑策略可潜在启发对VLA/WAM中视觉证据链的鲁棒性评估与攻击，但无直接结合。

papers.abstract: Tactile perception is crucial for precise robotic manipulation, providing an important foundation for dexterous, closed-loop force control. Among various tactile sensing techniques, magnetic tactile sensors stand out thanks to their fine-grained, three-dimensional force perception capability and strong robustness against visual occlusion. In this study, we discover a physical loophole called PhantomTac in magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can alter the magnetic field, thus spoofing the force interpreted by magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can stealthily deploy such an attack by simply attaching a thin (the thickness is around 0.5 mm), battery-free magnetic tag to the surface of an object. Hence, the attack tag can be easily concealed by a barcode sticker. Such an attack scheme is "deploy-and-forget" -- the attacker can deploy the tag and leave. When a robotic hand is picking up an object, it may severely damage the object. Specifically, spoofing the normal force can crush the object, whereas spoofing the shear force can lead to a loose grip, thus dropping the object. Compared with directly sabotaging the robotic hand, PhantomTac is much more concealed as the attacker does not need access to the device. We performed extensive reverse-engineering efforts to characterize the sensing mechanism of commercial-off-the-shelf tactile sensors and proposed a practical tag design. End-to-end evaluations conducted on real robots and robotic arms demonstrate that our attack can bypass existing anti-interference mechanisms and effectively hijack their closed-loop control processes, achieving an attack success rate exceeding 95% when the grasping-position offset is bounded within 8 mm. Finally, based on the limitations of existing anti-magnetic interference mechanisms, we propose a multimodal-consistency defense mechanism to mitigate such physical-layer security threats.

analysis.key_results: 攻击成功率超过95%（抓取位置偏移在8mm内），可绕过现有抗干扰机制。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现并利用磁性触觉传感器的物理漏洞，提出一种隐蔽、部署即忘的攻击方案，并设计多模态一致性防御机制。
analysis.method: 逆向分析商用触觉传感器特性，设计薄型无源磁标签进行磁场干扰，并评估其对机器人抓取控制的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 发现磁性触觉传感器存在物理漏洞，可通过粘贴无源磁标签欺骗力感知，劫持机器人闭环抓取控制，成功率超95%。

papers.abstract: Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

analysis.key_results: 在多种攻击类型和模型家族上取得了稳定且强大的检测性能，验证了理论预测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出结合素数量化空间和Gromov-Wasserstein度量的对抗样本检测方法，并建立了首个对抗检测的严格分离理论。
analysis.method: 构建两个互补的度量空间：CNN嵌入空间Z和素数量化空间P，利用对抗样本在这两个空间中的几何不一致性进行检测，并给出像素级吸收界、邻域直径集中性、Gromov-Wasserstein分离定理等理论保证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于素数量化空间与CNN嵌入空间几何差异的可证明对抗样本检测框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文聚焦于通用对抗样本检测的量化方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略；但与量化技术相关，对高效推理和模型压缩有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Embodied VLMs can execute increasingly complex manipulation tasks, yet execution errors can leave the environment in states that require replanning for recovery. Existing recovery methods either rely on inference-time mechanisms with fixed policies or learn from failure examples and reference corrections rather than verified action outcomes. To enable recovery learning through verifiable interaction, we introduce the Embodied Replanning for Recovery Environment (ERR-Env), which provides feedback on task progress and execution errors. We further construct ERR-Bench, a benchmark with held-out tasks spanning nominal, intermediate, and error states for evaluating recovery capability and execution reliability. We then propose Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO), an online reinforcement learning method combining turn-level rewards for task progress and error states with action-grouped advantage estimation, and use it to train ERR-VLM, a compact 2B embodied VLM. Evaluation on ERR-Bench reveals a mismatch between task progress and execution reliability across diverse VLMs. AGT-GSPO improves ERR-VLM by 10.25 percentage points in Strict Success Rate for error-free completion and 22.95 percentage points in Recovery Rate, while ablations and zero-shot transfer further validate the effectiveness of our method.

analysis.key_results: 在ERR-Bench上，AGT-GSPO使ERR-VLM的严格成功率（无错误完成）提高了10.25个百分点，恢复率提高了22.95个百分点；消融和零样本迁移进一步验证了方法有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了ERR-Env环境、ERR-Bench基准，以及动作分组Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO)在线强化学习方法，用于训练紧凑的2B具身VLM，提升错误恢复能力和执行可靠性。
analysis.method: AGT-GSPO，一种在线强化学习方法，结合了任务进展和错误状态的回合级奖励与动作分组优势估计；在ERR-Env中进行可验证交互训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个用于具身VLM错误恢复训练的交互环境、基准测试以及在线强化学习方法，显著提升了模型的恢复能力和执行可靠性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对具身VLA（Embodied VLM）的操纵任务错误恢复能力，提出环境、基准和训练方法，属于VLA领域的核心研究，与机器人动作执行和策略学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在多个真实世界基准测试中取得最先进整体性能，并展现出优于先进基线的推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一的深度生成框架ORBIT，包含Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE和Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer，用于层次化表示学习和低到高频的自回归生成。
analysis.method: Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE分解时间表示到不同频段并应用残差量化；Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer按低到高频顺序自回归生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文提出ORBIT，一种结合频率层次VQ-VAE和频段自回归Transformer的时间序列生成框架，以提升生成质量和推理效率。

papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

analysis.key_results: 将DiT-XL/2蒸馏到DiT-B/2后，在ImageNet 256×256上达到FID 2.58，实测相对DDIM-50加速2.25倍；消融实验支持轨迹监督和LTE路由优于随机决策且延迟接近。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TamedFlow方法，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机化轨迹监督训练压缩DiT，并引入可学习轨迹估计器在推理时路由草稿，缓解组合差距。
analysis.method: 在训练阶段利用交叉架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机化轨迹监督；推理阶段使用可学习轨迹估计器决定是否接受草稿，被拒绝的草稿回退并由教师模型校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对压缩扩散Transformer与学生自适应推理组合时的质量下降问题，提出轨迹感知蒸馏训练与推理时轨迹估计路由机制，实现无质量损失的加速采样。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于扩散Transformer的模型压缩与自适应推理，属于独立的高效推理技术，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，因此与本站主题无直接关系，但其轨迹感知蒸馏和路由机制可为未来VLA/WAM的高效推理提供方法论参考。

papers.abstract: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.

analysis.key_results: LLaVA-1.5-7B在三种split上F1分别为0.8221、0.8498、0.8713；错误的预测比正确的预测关注更多图像区域（Cohen's d=-0.46，p=1.4×10^-24）；直接移植token ID导致F1降至0.00，而tokenizer派生读取保持在0.80-0.92。
analysis.limitations: 无法确定已有论文报告的增益有多少是由匹配的评估保留的，因为参考运行使用了4-bit NF4量化，且比较尚未解决。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现POPE评估中的token读取方法存在系统性混淆，adversarial split的F1分数因读取方式不同可产生6.13点的变化，并提出tokenizer派生的读取方法可稳定评估。
analysis.method: 系统审计四个VLM和三个tokenizer家族，对比二token logit读取、八token查找等不同是/否提取方法，并进行3,000问题的注意力探针分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文系统审计了POPE基准中VLM幻觉评估的是/否token提取方法，发现token集选择对F1分数有显著影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于VLM幻觉评估基准的token提取方法，不涉及VLA或WAM，但与模型量化（4-bit NF4）有一定关联。

papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实世界任务中，PaceVLA 在多种机器人本体上提升执行效率并保持任务成功率，包括长程和灵巧操作任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PaceVLA 统一框架，集成模式特定动作解码器和可量化性引导的模式选择方案，实现 VLA 模型中的自适应时序动作量化。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: PaceVLA 提出一种自适应时序动作量化框架，通过模式特定解码器与可量化性引导的模式选择，在保持成功率的同时提升 VLA 机器人策略的执行效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型的执行效率问题，提出时序动作量化方法，属于 VLA 与模型量化/高效推理的交叉研究，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

analysis.key_results: 在Simpler-WidowX上从58.7%提升至69.8%（+11.1个百分点），LIBERO上达到97.2%，真实世界任务达到52.8%，RMBench记忆依赖任务为21.6%。
analysis.limitations: 在较难的依赖多观测的任务上暴露有限历史窗口的局限性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CondenseVLA，一种多帧VLA策略，在解码端引入可学习历史压缩模块，将历史观测压缩为有限槽令牌，并通过辅助正则化减少槽冗余、鼓励互补注意力。
analysis.method: 使用可学习查询和多头交叉注意力将缓存的逐帧特征压缩为固定数量的槽令牌；通过惩罚槽注意力图重叠和去相关槽嵌入的正则化减少冗余。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CondenseVLA提出在VLA解码端增加可学习历史压缩模块，将多帧视觉特征压缩为固定槽令牌，以高效利用短期视觉上下文进行动作预测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA的高效历史推理进行优化，通过压缩历史视觉特征降低计算开销，与视觉-语言-动作模型及高效推理主题高度相关。

Across multiple benchmarks, including Simpler, LIBERO, and real-world robot experiments, CondenseVLA consistently outperforms the CronusVLA baseline.

papers.abstract: Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach. In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors. Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities. We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably. Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.

analysis.key_results: 在物理机器人河内塔操作中达到100%成功率；在仿真基准上比最强世界模型高出13.3-85.3个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM）框架，通过离散潜在预测器和连续视觉反馈控制器，实现长时程操作任务的高成功率与强泛化能力。
analysis.method: 离散潜在预测器基于向量量化潜在状态建模转移，规划器通过离散搜索寻找最短路径，连续学习控制器通过视觉反馈依次到达计划状态；采用首次通过时间估计器作为拟度量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM），结合离散长时程搜索与连续视觉反馈控制，实现机器人操作的长时程规划与执行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的长时程规划问题，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。论文展示了VQ-WM相对于现有VLA和WAM方法的优势，特别是在仅使用短时演示数据时能组合出超出训练分布的长时程解决方案。

figures.caption: Overview of VQ-WM. The initial (green) and goal (red) images are encoded into latent states and vector-quantized according to controller reachability, so that each vector-quantized state serves as a target the controller is expected to reach. The planner performs discrete search over these vector-quantized states using a discrete latent predictor. A continuous controller then drives the robot toward each planned target in turn, using visual feedback to correct deviations along the way.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: VQ-WM components and pipeline. (a) Inference encodes the initial and goal images, searches over state codes, and executes the planned targets with visual feedback. (b) Offline training learns the controller and continuous latent predictor, performs state vector quantization using first-passage time, and then learns vector-quantized latent dynamics.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $\pi_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0基准上，对π0.5、SmolVLA、X-VLA和MolmoAct2共16个模型-基准组合进行评估，VLA-Rolling在所有组合中降低了动作块推理成本，最高加速1.48倍，并在14个组合中提升了成功率，最高提升15.08个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现动作尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进度，并设计VLA-Rolling框架，通过动作尾部继承、置信度估计和置信引导的细化，在冻结VLA模型的情况下降低推理成本并提升成功率。
analysis.method: VLA-Rolling推理框架，包含三个阶段：动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计、通过重噪声和去噪预算分配的置信引导细化；在滑动时域执行中重用未被执行的去噪动作尾部。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个轻量级推理框架VLA-Rolling，通过重用被丢弃的动作尾部并自适应分配去噪预算，在多种VLA模型和机器人基准上实现了更高效和更准确的动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理加速，属于VLA高效推理的核心主题。它不涉及世界模型或WAM，但通过重用去噪过程中的动作尾部并自适应分配计算预算，为机器人策略的实时执行提供了实用且广泛适用的优化方法。

papers.abstract: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.

analysis.key_results: 对齐后差距大幅缩小；接受率可通过低成本的DCore方法提升；吞吐量收益受任务不确定性和服务条件影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 建立跨训练、推理和评估的比较协议，重新测量已发布检查点并在共享目标生成数据上重训六种草稿模型，揭示对齐条件后原本较大的性能差距显著缩小，并提出DCore作为低成本强基线。
analysis.method: 在十个基准和两个目标模型上，统一训练与推理条件，比较不同草稿模型配方，分析接受率提升的不同成本路径（如目标函数、上下文调整或令牌到令牌条件化）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作通过受控对比研究探讨投机解码中接受率提升是否以及在何种条件下转化为吞吐量收益。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用投机解码方法，不直接涉及VLA/WAM或机器人领域；但其高效推理协议和低成本草稿设计对机器人策略或世界模型的推理加速具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

analysis.key_results: 在同规模模型中（Gemma4-31B、Qwen3.6-27B）在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成上取得最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并开源Muse Glimmer 30B模型，以约4-bit量化实现单GPU高效推理，在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成等基准上达到同规模最优。
analysis.method: 训练一个带感知编码器的30B因果语言模型，接受文本和图像输入，集成多步推理、可靠工具使用和失败恢复，并量化为约4-bit精度以支持本地部署。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入开源30B参数因果语言模型Muse Glimmer，集成感知编码器、4-bit量化与多步推理、工具使用和失败恢复能力，面向消费级硬件上的自主智能体任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是独立的高效推理工作，通过4-bit量化在消费级硬件上部署大规模语言模型，未直接涉及VLA或世界模型；但量化技术对VLA/WAM的端侧部署具有方法借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 方法在多个下游任务上一致提升现有位置编码器性能，且RevGeoRQ进一步超越当代位置编码器。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并设计了RevGeoRQ架构，同时使用残差量化语义ID提供可解释的地理表示。
analysis.method: 使用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号，应用于现有位置编码器架构；提出RevGeoRQ自定义架构，采用残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并引入RevGeoRQ架构及残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究地理位置编码器，采用残差量化技术，与本站VLA/WAM主题无直接关系；但残差量化语义ID表示对量化方法在空间表示学习中的应用具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, gives the agent a thin harness: one command line that turns its commands into robot motion and makes no decisions of its own. On the robot, the agent keeps doing what it does best: it reads output, writes code and runs tests. Two agents of the same model share the work. An acting agent runs each episode. After a failure, an optimizer agent reads the full record of the episode, with every command, image and message, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools, each with its own tests. What the agents learn stays as code, and no demonstrations or training are needed. At run time, the tools use only what a real robot also has: RGB images, camera calibration and the state of the arms. They find objects by triangulation between camera views. Because these inputs are the same in simulation and on hardware, the tools move to a real robot with a different arm after only a small change for the arm. We build the tools on ten layouts of one seed per task with Codex and GPT-6-Astra and freeze them; the eight Open tasks share one set of tools. In RoboDojo's official evaluation on a hidden seed, 50 episodes for each of the 42 tasks, HexaShell reaches 46.9% success and a progress score of 53.2, the state of the art on the official RoboDojo leaderboard. The limit is contact, not reasoning: memory tasks reach 81.0%, but precision tasks only 32.0%. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo官方评测中，42个任务各50轮，达到46.9%成功率和53.2进度分，为官方排行榜最优；记忆类任务成功率81.0%，精密类任务仅32.0%。
analysis.limitations: 性能瓶颈在接触操作而非推理；精密操作任务成功率较低（32.0%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HexaShell，一个将VLM转用于机器人控制的薄型接口，通过让代理编写代码工具实现跨仿真到真机的泛化，并在RoboDojo基准上取得最优成绩。
analysis.method: 使用两个VLM代理分工：一个执行，一个优化；代理通过命令行接口控制机器人，通过三角测量定位物体，并编写带测试的工具；工具在仿真和硬件上共享，迁移到不同机械臂只需小改。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出HexaShell，一个薄型接口，让VLM代理直接控制机器人并通过角色分工和工具学习在仿真与真实间迁移，在RoboDojo排行榜上取得最优成绩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向VLA（视觉-语言-动作）智能体在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出以代码作为策略表示的新方法；虽然不显式构建世界模型或动作世界模型，但其工具学习和跨仿真-真实迁移的方法对机器人学习策略有直接价值，可视为一种替代传统VLA行为克隆的途径。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn a wide range of robotic skills, but combining separately trained skills remains challenging. The original training data may be unavailable for joint retraining, while directly merging model weights can cause interference. We propose NestedVLA, which consolidates independently fine-tuned VLA policies without access to their original training data. Instead of merging all updates into one checkpoint, a hypernetwork embedded in the VLA generates action-expert weight updates for a selected task. Each task's compressed vision-language model update is stored separately, and both updates are added to a frozen base VLA to instantiate the corresponding policy. We evaluate NestedVLA by consolidating three policies fine-tuned with reinforcement learning on MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and CALVIN. It achieves 66.7% average success, improving on the strongest model-merging baseline by 41.1 percentage points. It performs within 1 percentage point of per-task fine-tuning on ManiSkill and substantially narrows the gap on CALVIN. In this three-policy setting, total storage is 1.5x that of a single full checkpoint. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和CALVIN上整合三个强化学习微调策略，平均成功率66.7%，比最强模型合并基线提高41.1个百分点；在ManiSkill上性能与单任务微调相差1个百分点以内，在CALVIN上大幅缩小差距；三策略设置下总存储是单个完整检查点的1.5倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NestedVLA，一种无需原始训练数据即可整合独立微调VLA策略的方法，通过超网络为选定任务生成动作专家更新，并将压缩的视觉-语言模型更新分开存储。
analysis.method: 在冻结的基础VLA上嵌入超网络，为选定任务生成动作专家权重更新；每个任务的压缩VLM更新单独存储，并与基础模型相结合实现策略实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NestedVLA通过超网络生成动作专家权重更新，将独立微调的VLA策略整合到一个框架中，无需访问原始训练数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦VLA模型，解决多技能策略整合问题，核心贡献在于无需原始数据的技能融合与生成机制，对VLA在机器人技能学习中的实用化有直接价值。

(b) NestedVLA retains a compressed task-specific VLM update and uses an embedded task-conditioned hypernetwork to generate the action-expert update. Both updates are applied to a shared base to materialize the selected VLA.

figures.caption: NestedVLA pipeline. (1) Skill acquisition : each task is fine-tuned independently from the same base Θ 0 \Theta_{0} and the resulting task vector τ m \tau_{m} is compressed into a sparse skill z m = α ⋅ τ m ⊙ M m z_{m}=\alpha\cdot\tau_{m}\odot M_{m} via drop-and-rescale. (2) Skill consolidation : a single nested hypernetwork 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} is trained against the action-expert portions of { z m } \{z_{m}\} with a multi-task masked MSE loss. (3) Skill generation : at inference, querying 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} with task id m m generates the action-expert update; the corresponding compressed VLM update is retrieved and both compose with the frozen base.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts action-prediction latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 和 SIMPLER 仿真中，LLM 主干 FLOPs 降低 35-59%，动作延迟降低 9-32%（1.09-1.46 倍加速），成功率保持；在 Franka Research 3 真机上，动作预测延迟降低 20%（1.25 倍加速），成功率相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 FastVLA，一个训练无关、任务感知、时间自适应的视觉 token 压缩框架，通过任务到视觉注意力打分与基于逆辛普森指标的在线滑动窗口校准，动态设置压缩率，提升 VLA 模型闭环部署的推理效率。
analysis.method: 任务到视觉注意力打分评估 token 重要性；逆辛普森指标衡量重要性分布均匀性；在线滑动窗口校准自适应设定每步压缩率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FastVLA 提出一种无需训练、任务感知且时间自适应的视觉标记压缩框架，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低 VLA 模型的推理延迟和计算量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型（OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT）的推理效率问题，提出视觉 token 压缩方法，属于 VLA 推理加速的专门优化，与本站 VLA 主题高度相关，不直接涉及 WAM。

papers.abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

analysis.key_results: 在六个3D基准上平均准确率53.2%，比基础Qwen模型提升22.0%，超越Gemini 3.6 Flash，相比现有开源3D方法使用少50-70%的输入帧，并在未见领域平均提升5.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ACT3D模型，通过强化学习使视觉语言模型学会主动探索3D环境，无需多视图或3D表示，并基于最终答案正确性塑造探索策略。
analysis.method: 初始轨迹监督微调后使用强化学习，奖励主要由最终答案正确性驱动，模型通过迭代推理、导航和视点重定向来交互式探索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过仅使用单张图像输入，让视觉语言模型在与3D环境交互中学习思考和主动探索，从而提升视觉问答的准确性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究视觉语言模型在3D环境中的主动探索和策略学习，对世界模型和机器人学习中关于环境交互与信息获取的策略有价值，但与机器人动作预测或世界动作模型无直接关联。

figures.caption: Learning to reason and explore in 3D. Unlike prior methods with passive perception which assumes receive complete 3D representations as input, Act3D treats 3D representations as interactive environments, learning to alternate between reasoning and actions to actively explore the 3D world before committing an answer.

papers.abstract: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which runs the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head on the device to build a deep chain and uses one SLM pass to add alternative branches. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An {\epsilon}-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three runs of each system on Spec-Bench show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-{\epsilon}. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

analysis.key_results: 在Galaxy S26 Ultra上，相比服务器端MTP自推测，HyCo在Spec-Bench上减少38.6%的GPU时间，在32K摘要上减少29.2%；与SLM-only草稿相比，节省多9.0个百分点，交付速度1.9倍；与Cloud+MTP的裁判评分差为+0.2（95% CI: -0.9至+1.3）；无松弛时节省分别为27.7%和11.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HyCo混合草稿生成框架，利用设备上的服务器模型MTP头与小型语言模型协同构建深层草稿树，减少移动NPU上的重复推理，提高推测解码效率。
analysis.method: 服务器返回隐藏状态、输入嵌入和键值对以支持设备端MTP头；使用量化、受限词汇表和1K令牌窗口适配移动NPU；引入ε阈值规则放宽对验证器采样分布的精确保持。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HyCo通过将服务器模型的多令牌预测头部署到设备端并结合小型语言模型单次推理，实现移动-云推测解码的深度链与分支构建，从而降低服务器计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通用推测解码的效率优化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但与本站关注的模型效率主题（推测解码、量化）有交集，可为其在机器人推理中的潜在应用提供方法参考。

papers.abstract: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $\pi_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $\pi_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.

analysis.key_results: 四个真实世界任务套件中，FoveaVLA-Single成功率70.8%，FoveaVLA-Dual成功率77.1%，腕部相机基线为52.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FoveaVLA，用学习到的注视动作替代腕部相机，在VLA中实现高效的细节感知。
analysis.method: 在π0.5基础上，预测下一步观察的交互区域，并将原分辨率裁剪的注视区域与全视图一起输入策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FoveaVLA通过预测注视区域并融合局部与原图特征，在VLA中替代腕部相机，提升操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于VLA研究，通过主动注视替代腕部相机，提升机器人操作中的视觉感知效率。

The π0.5 wrist-equipped matches it when the target is already in the wrist view, but degrades with distractors and far-away objects, where FoveaVLA’s foveal crop keeps the relevant detail in sight.

From this shared representation, the action expert generates an action chunk, while the language-model head autoregressively generates interaction boxes that select the foveal crops for the next observation. Dual adds the same four image inputs from a second external view and predicts one box per view.

papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present VLX-GO, a vision-language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/om-ai-lab/VLX-Go.

analysis.key_results: 在干扰跟踪成功率上，完整多阶段训练达到55.80%（基线OmTrackVLA为41.54%），在线精化后进一步提高到58.22%，碰撞率降低1.99个百分点，在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰和模糊跟踪成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLX-Go，一个多阶段训练的视觉-语言航点策略，用于在干扰人群中鲁棒地跟踪指定人员，并通过在线策略精化进一步提升性能。
analysis.method: 结合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文、Transformer主干和轻量级航点预测头；训练依次进行视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理微调和跟踪任务专业化，并使用过滤的预言机标签进行在线策略精化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种视觉-语言航点策略VLX-Go，通过多阶段学习（视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理、跟踪专业化）和在线策略精化，提升有人环境中人员跟随的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在具身跟踪任务中的应用，与VLA主题核心相关；未涉及世界模型（WAM）。

figures.caption: VLX-Go architecture and training workflow. (A) Frozen DINOv3 and SigLIP features are concatenated and pooled into 188 visual tokens: 31 × ( 2 × 2 ) 31\times(2\times 2) for history and 8 × 8 8\times 8 for the current frame. A vision–language adapter projects these features into a transformer backbone; temporal/view indicators, instruction tokens, and a learnable action query complete the input. A three-layer MLP decodes the action state into eight robot-centric waypoints. (B) Three offline stages train the adapter, then the backbone and adapter, and finally the backbone, adapter, and waypoint head. (C) DAgger collects policy rollouts, labels visited states with the oracle, filters the labels, and fine-tunes on aggregated rollouts and demonstrations. The updated policy supplies the next round of rollouts. Visual encoders remain frozen throughout. Scene and robot images are illustrative.

papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

analysis.key_results: 在模型基动作判别中，SonoWorld在高达74.8%的试验中正确将目标导向探针运动排在等幅反向运动之上；通过用户研究验证了可控性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SonoWorld，一个因果超声世界模型，从无标签临床视频学习视频动态，并通过小型EM跟踪数据集将其接地到6-DoF控制，为机器人超声提供数据驱动的交互式环境。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练：在大规模无标签多器官超声帧上预训练潜动作条件视频扩散模型；使用小型EM跟踪甲状腺数据集将视频动态接地到度量探针位姿；应用分布匹配蒸馏实现因果、长时程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性缓存驱逐token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个因果、位姿可控的超声世界模型SonoWorld，用于机器人超声数据采集与策略评估。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是构建可位姿控制的超声世界模型，属于机器人世界模型研究，可直接为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供仿真环境，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Three stages of ultrasound world model development. (a) Pretraining. A bidirectional DiT is trained on large-scale unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound videos, conditioned on the diffusion timestep t t and latent actions 𝐳 \mathbf{z} via adaptive layer normalization. (b) Post-training. The model is then post-trained on high-quality thyroid ultrasound videos paired with EM tracker poses, replacing the latent action with the physical action. (c) Causal transform. The bidirectional model is finally distilled into a causal DiT via distribution matching distillation (DMD) Yin et al. (2024) .

papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上跨视觉和文本任务，相比原始自推测方法一致提升高达11%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SP²ec（Single-Peak SPeculative decoding），一种免训练的bandit算法，在自推测解码中自适应调整草稿配置，并理论保证墙钟时间遗憾（wall-time regret）最小化。
analysis.method: 利用自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，采用bandit算法动态选择草稿配置，显式最小化每个查询的墙钟时间遗憾。
