papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三个真实世界操作任务上平均真实世界成功率达88.3%（最强基线为76.7%）；在WorldArena中三项动作条件世界建模任务均领先；AC-WM联合训练改善所有动作接口的生成，PAIR将OOD成功率从63.3%提升到76.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniW(A)M框架，利用混合专家扩散Transformer统一动作条件世界建模和多种WAM变体，并设计PAIR插件式自适应接口路由器，在冻结骨干网络的情况下根据目标任务块场景选择合适接口。
analysis.method: 基于扩散Transformer的混合专家模型，共享专家捕捉通用动态，原子能力专家跨接口复用；部署时通过PAIR从少量目标任务块场景中学习接口选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一的世界与世界-动作模型混合专家框架UniW(A)M，共享物理动态并通过自适应接口路由平衡任务成功率和执行效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦世界-动作模型（WAM），统一世界建模与动作生成，并通过联合训练和自适应路由提升机器人操作中的OOD泛化能力和执行效率，对本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models can be run using frameworks such as vLLM and MLX, with quantized versions available to reduce memory usage.Inference code and links to model weights are available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Startlux-Decision .

analysis.key_results: 在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant模型比最强可比规模开放权重决策模型高出7.4-16.9分；27B AutoThink达到73.4分。RLCD²将推理跟踪在生成限制内终止的比例提高最多48个百分点，平均推理长度减少最多65%。在DecisionPivot上，AutoThink比Instant对应模型准确率高出11.5-18.4分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了StartLux-Decision决策模型，包括Instant（单遍）和AutoThink（自适应推理）变体，以及RLCD²强化学习方法，用于校准决策置信度并控制推理令牌长度，同时保持准确性。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练管线：共享能力训练、变体专业化、AutoThink推理监督与强化学习；RLCD²使用冻结模型和proper scoring rules优化决策概率质量并惩罚过长推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了从0.8B到27B参数的决策模型系列，结合单遍高效预测与自适应推理，并引入RLCD²方法以校准推理长度并提高效率。

papers.abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) on a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases. The fine-tuned model reaches 95.42% accuracy (95% CI 91.98-97.42%) and a macro F1 of 0.9551, up from 65.00% for the unadapted weights (62.92% through the remote API). However, TF-IDF linear SVM and logistic regression baselines trained on the same split reach 98.75% (95% CI 96.39-99.57%) with sub-millisecond CPU inference, so on this benchmark the fine-tuned model offers no accuracy advantage over a well-tuned linear classifier. A Leave-One-Symptom-Out clause-ablation analysis of four illustrative narratives shows predictions depending on distinguishing clauses: in a psoriasis example, removing the clause describing silvery scales lowers the predicted probability from above 99.99% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo, while removing other clauses changes it by less than 0.001 percentage points. Decision architectures deliver structured, single-pass predictions from large language backbones, but short, lexically distinctive benchmarks such as Symptom2Disease cannot show an advantage over simple baselines; validation on longer, real clinical text and clinician review are needed.

analysis.key_results: 微调模型准确率达95.42%，宏观F1为0.9551；TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线准确率达98.75%；消融分析显示预测强烈依赖于区分性症状描述。
analysis.limitations: 在短、词汇特征明显的基准数据集上，微调模型无法超越简单基线；需要在更长、真实的临床文本上验证并经临床医生审查。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了在Symptom2Disease基准上，经过4-bit QLoRA微调的90亿参数决策模型虽然大幅提升了准确率，但与简单的TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线相比没有优势。
analysis.method: 使用QLoRA（4-bit量化的低秩适应）对基于Qwen3.5的Clef-Flash决策模型进行微调，并与TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线进行比较，还进行了Leave-One-Symptom-Out消融分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究微调了一个90亿参数的决策基础模型用于症状到疾病分类，并将其与简单的TF-IDF线性基线进行对比，结果显示微调模型在准确率上并不占优。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究的是语言模型量化微调在文本分类任务上的效果，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）没有直接关系，但量化方法可作为参考。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

analysis.key_results: 在EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark及多令牌预测模块等多种投机解码方法上，DLoop将墙钟加速比提高了5%至41%，同时保持无损解码。
analysis.main_contribution: DLoop方法：循环投机解码，在验证前进行多轮起草，并利用循环感知训练保持草稿模型可靠性。
analysis.method: DLoop：在草稿模型自信时继续起草，累积多个草稿阶段的令牌，然后一次性验证；循环感知训练使草稿模型适应自身未验证令牌的隐藏状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DLoop，一种循环形式的投机解码，在验证前自适应地执行多个起草阶段，以减少目标模型的前向传播次数并提升加速比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用大语言模型的投机解码，未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、世界-动作模型（WAM）或机器人领域，但与VLA/WAM的高效推理加速有潜在方法学借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) enable unified audio-video understanding, but their long multimodal token sequences make deployment computationally expensive. Token compression reduces this cost, yet aggressive compression often lowers accuracy. Existing works predominantly focus on designing better compression mechanisms; however, adapting the underlying language model to reason effectively over the remaining compressed context remains under-explored. To address this, we propose CAFD (Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation), a ground-truth-free self-distillation framework that adapts OmniLLMs to fixed compression pipelines without requiring reference answers, rationales, or correctness rewards. CAFD leverages the full-token view of the same multimodal sample as a source of privileged information: a full-context self-teacher provides soft target supervision to a compressed-context student along the student's on-policy trajectory. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B across five audio-video benchmarks, five compression pipelines, and five deployment budgets, CAFD demonstrates consistent gains, improving 120 out of 125 conditions with an average accuracy boost of 1.44 points and recovering 26.9% of the accuracy gap on average. These results demonstrate that the proposed ground-truth-free adaptation offers an effective and practical route to improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployed OmniLLMs.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上于5个音视频基准、5种压缩流程和5种部署预算下，120/125条件下获得提升，平均准确率提升1.44点，平均恢复26.9%的精度差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CAFD（Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation），一种无真值自蒸馏方法，使全模态大语言模型适应固定压缩流程，无需参考答案或奖励。
analysis.method: 利用同一样本的全token视图作为特权信息，以全上下文自教师模型向压缩上下文学生模型沿在策略轨迹提供软目标监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CAFD框架，通过全上下文自蒸馏在无真值条件下让全模态大语言模型适应固定压缩流程，提升压缩后推理精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文关注全模态大语言模型压缩上下文的自蒸馏适应，属于高效推理方法，非VLA/WAM或机器人领域；其无真值蒸馏思路对VLA/WAM的上下文压缩适应有一定借鉴意义，但无直接结合。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Compressed Context: Ground-Truth-Free Adaptation of OmniLLMs via Self-Distillation

papers.abstract: Humans typically rely on vision, touch, hearing, and proprioception to perceive contact and adapt their actions during manipulation. Providing robots with comparable responsiveness therefore requires hardware that can retain and use these complementary sensory signals. Most imitation-learning systems, however, observe demonstrations primarily through vision and proprioception, limiting access to contact information that is difficult to infer visually. We present PolyUMI, an open-source platform for scalable visual--tactile--audio demonstration collection and robot deployment. Its lightweight, wireless handheld gripper records synchronized wrist-camera, optical tactile, contact-audio, and proprioceptive observations without requiring a tethered workstation. The same sensing finger can be transferred to the robot end effector, preserving the sensing geometry between demonstration collection and policy execution. To effectively use these heterogeneous observations, we further introduce VisTA, a token-level multimodal policy that integrates information across sensors and time to predict contact-aware robot actions. Experiments spanning object inference, slip control, and contact-rich manipulation show that touch and audio reveal task-relevant information beyond vision and that VisTA is competitive with or outperforms existing multimodal policies. Together, PolyUMI and VisTA provide an accessible pipeline for collecting multimodal demonstrations and learning policies that perceive physical interaction beyond vision. Project Page: https://polyumi-vista.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在物体推理、滑动控制和接触丰富操作等实验中，触觉和音频揭示了视觉之外的任务相关信息，VisTA与现有多模态策略相比具有竞争力或更优性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出开源平台PolyUMI，支持可扩展的视觉-触觉-音频演示采集与机器人部署；同时提出VisTA，一种令牌级多模态策略，融合多传感器时间信息以预测接触感知动作。
analysis.method: PolyUMI使用轻量无线手持夹爪同步记录腕部相机、光触觉、接触音频和本体感觉数据，且同一传感手指可迁移至机器人末端以保持传感几何；VisTA采用令牌级多模态策略整合多传感器与时间信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 介绍PolyUMI开源平台和VisTA多模态策略，用于同步采集视觉-触觉-音频-本体感觉数据并学习接触感知的机器人操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和机器人操作，提供多模态数据采集与策略学习方法，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in embodied manipulation, but still struggle to distinguish between changes that should preserve behavior and those that require different actions. We identify two complementary failure modes. Under task-preserving changes, where task semantics remain unchanged but scene appearance varies (e.g., style, illumination, clutter, or paraphrasing), policies often exhibit unnecessary action drift. Conversely, under semantic-breaking changes, where key task semantics such as the target object or constraint are altered, policies frequently continue following the original trajectory instead of adapting to the new task. To address these failures, we propose BAS-VLA, a task-semantic action calibration framework built on top of a frozen base VLA. BAS-VLA adopts a breaking-centered calibration core as its default path, complemented by a selective evidence-gated preserving auxiliary that corrects appearance-induced drift when task-preserving evidence is strong. Across four target-object swap tasks, BAS-VLA improves changed-task success from 2.3% to 68.5% while maintaining strong clean and semantics-preserving performance and suppressing outdated behavior. On validated style-preserving shifts, it further improves success from 42% to 70% without degrading clean performance. These results demonstrate the importance of calibrating VLA policies to remain stable when task semantics are preserved and adapt when task semantics change.

analysis.key_results: 在四个目标物体交换任务中，变化任务成功率从2.3%提升至68.5%，同时保持干净的基线性能和语义保持性能，并抑制过时行为；在验证的风格保持偏移上，成功率从42%提升至70%，且不降低干净性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BAS-VLA，一个基于冻结基础VLA的任务语义动作校准框架，包含以破坏为中心的校准核心和选择性证据门控的保持辅助机制，能抑制外观诱导的动作漂移并适应语义变化。
analysis.method: 在冻结VLA上构建BAS-VLA框架：默认采用以破坏为中心的校准核心，辅以选择性证据门控的保持辅助，用于纠正外观导致的动作漂移，并在语义变化时调整动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出BAS-VLA框架，通过在冻结VLA上校准任务语义动作，解决策略在任务保持变化下发生无关动作漂移、以及在语义破坏变化下沿用旧轨迹的问题。

papers.abstract: Factory work is a promising early scenario for embodied AI: assigning repetitive manual jobs to robots has clear economic payoff, and a structured station keeps the jobs tractable for current policies. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models now dominate as the policy paradigm for these robots. The inference latency of VLA models directly affects robot responsiveness and motion smoothness. However, existing VLA inference frameworks do not fully exploit the characteristics of embodied workloads or account for the distinct bottlenecks across different stages of VLA inference. In this paper, we first characterize embodied workloads and identify substantial task similarity across repeated robot executions. We further find that such similarity extends beyond observations and action trajectories to internal model states. Drawing on these observations, we present rMuscle, a real-time VLA inference framework inspired by human muscle memory. It exploits cross-execution similarity through a dual-phase muscle-memory cache. The Context Cache reuses visual-token outputs to reduce computation, while the Action Cache reuses neuron activation patterns to reduce weight accesses. We keep both the cache memory footprint and access overhead low through online cache recomputation, sliding-window cache retrieval, and mask sharing across consecutive denoising steps. rMuscle achieves 1.29-1.42X speedup on RTX 4090 and Jetson Thor across LIBERO, RoboTwin, and physical manipulation tasks, while maintaining the original success rates on real-world robots.

analysis.key_results: 在RTX 4090和Jetson Thor上，在LIBERO、RoboTwin及物理操作任务中实现1.29-1.42倍加速，真实机器人任务成功率与原模型持平。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出rMuscle实时推理框架，通过双阶段肌肉记忆缓存（上下文缓存和动作缓存）利用跨执行相似性，在保持成功率的同时加速VLA推理。
analysis.method: 双阶段缓存：上下文缓存重用视觉token输出减少计算，动作缓存重用神经元激活模式减少权重访问；通过在线缓存重计算、滑动窗口检索和去噪步骤间掩码共享控制开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出rMuscle框架，利用跨执行任务相似性缓存视觉令牌和神经元激活模式，实现VLA模型实时推理加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型推理效率进行优化，通过缓存跨执行相似性加速推理，属于VLA领域的高效推理方法，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$\pi$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

analysis.key_results: 在多个仿真和真实世界基准上，LayerRoute一致提升StarVLA-π和π0.5，在LIBERO Long上获得最高7.2的提升，且仅增加0.31%/3.87%的额外参数。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LayerRoute，一个动作条件表示路由接口，包含Layer Mixture Router和Action-State Reread，能自适应访问VLM层和动作表示，在LIBERO Long等基准上提升StarVLA-π和π0.5的性能。
analysis.method: 通过Layer Mixture Router动态形成缓存的VLM表示的混合，并通过Action-State Reread重用早期的动作表示，实现动作条件化的层路由。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LayerRoute动作条件表示路由接口，动态混合VLM层表示并重用动作状态，以提升VLA策略性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中表示访问的灵活性进行改进，通过自适应路由VLM层和动作状态，属于VLA策略核心架构的优化，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents require more than retrieval over stored conversations: they must preserve source evidence, revise outdated knowledge, and distinguish relevant memories from sufficient support for an answer. We present ECHO (Embodied Context & History Orchestration), an auditable dual-path memory system. A fast path captures immutable events and serves multi-route recall, while asynchronous workers consolidate experience into revisable state and rebuild derived indexes. Source provenance, temporal authority, and answer realization are explicit boundaries. The service supports original-source packets with evidence-use checks and disables model-based reranking by default. For the latest reported accuracy, the authors confirm mixed retrieved inputs comprising original dialogue and memory summaries, answered by Qwen3-8B with NF4 quantization. In the latest author-supplied five-system aggregate evaluation, ECHO reports 56.27% answer accuracy, 98.04% source Hit@10, 93.58% macro source Recall@5, and 13.92% hallucination flags, with 19.54 ms mean retrieval latency. Its reported accuracy exceeds Mem0 by 4.53 percentage points in this snapshot. The results are descriptive aggregates; matched question-level evaluation and generation latency remain to be established. We separate these observations from earlier published experiments and engineering regressions.

analysis.key_results: 在最新的五系统聚合评估中，ECHO 报告 56.27% 答案准确率、98.04% 源 Hit@10、93.58% 宏源 Recall@5、13.92% 幻觉标记，平均检索延迟 19.54 ms；其报告准确率比 Mem0 高 4.53 个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 结果为描述性聚合；问题级评估与生成延迟尚未建立；作者将观测结果与早期实验及工程回归分离。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ECHO（Embodied Context & History Orchestration）双路径记忆系统，将不可变事件快速存储与异步经验合并为可修订状态，并显式区分源出处、时间权威性与答案实现边界。
analysis.method: 双路径记忆系统：快速路径捕获不可变事件并支持多路由召回；异步工作器合并经验为可修订状态并重建派生索引；服务使用原始源包与证据使用检查，默认禁用基于模型的重排序；答案由 Qwen3-8B 结合 NF4 量化生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 ECHO 双路径记忆系统，通过快速事件存储与异步经验合并实现可审计的长程智能体记忆，其中模型使用 NF4 量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是长期记忆系统，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模；其使用 NF4 量化以获得高效推理，与模型量化主题有直接关联，但对本站支持的 VLA/WAM 主题无直接方法论贡献。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.

analysis.key_results: 在 NAVSIMv1 和 NAVSIMv2 基准上，达到 94.1 PDMS（Navtest）和 47.0 EPDMS（Navhard），测试时训练反向传播延迟开销仅 26.44 ms，且通过记忆扩展可实现免训练的性能提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DriveVLA-M0，一个具有故障感知潜在记忆的检索增强 VLA 模型，能够利用过去的失败案例，在推理时通过轻量级 LoRA 测试时训练进行场景特定的修正，无需修改主干网络。
analysis.method: 构建存储故障案例及其结构化场景表示和专家轨迹标签的潜在记忆池；设计检索模型解耦静态道路结构和动态智能体交互；推理时通过解耦的 LoRA 测试时训练机制注入检索案例。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种检索增强的 VLA 模型 DriveVLA-M0，利用故障感知潜在记忆和基于 LoRA 的测试时训练实现自动驾驶中的场景特定修正。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型在自动驾驶中的性能提升，通过故障感知记忆增强和测试时训练实现自适应修正，属于 VLA 领域的高相关研究，特别是对机器人策略学习和高效推理的交叉方向具有参考价值。

figures.caption: We propose DriveVLA-M0, a failure-aware memory augmentation VLA framework. (a) Classic VLA: VLMs perform scene reasoning in vision-language space and pass intermediate features to an Action Decoder for planning. The red trajectories indicate the model’s likely selections. (b) Ours: We retrieve structurally similar failure cases using Retrieved Model from a latent memory pool and inject them into the Action Decoder via LoRA-based test-time training for scenario-specific correction. figures.caption: Overview of DriveVLA-M0. (Top) [M] Memory Generation: Scenarios where the base model underperforms are identified via oracle simulation scoring, and their intermediate features are stored in latent memory 𝕄 \mathbb{M} . (Bottom) [I] Inference with TTT: At test time, structurally similar cases are retrieved from 𝕄 \mathbb{M} based on the current scene features, and the retrieved contents are used to fine-tune the Action Decoder via Decoupled LoRA. Specifically, cases retrieved by map features are utilized to adapt the Map (Static) LoRA branch, while cases retrieved by agent features are used to adapt the Agent (Dynamic) LoRA branch, enabling targeted and scenario-specific planning correction.

papers.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) can clone a voice from seconds of audio. Yet the quality comes from billion-parameter diffusion transformers whose size and multi-step sampling put them out of reach of the on-device, assistive, and real-time applications that need them most. Post-training quantization (PTQ) shrinks such models without retraining, but it has been built for language and vision, not speech. At 4 bits, a strong quantizer leaves intelligibility close to full precision but consistently erodes speaker timbre, so error rates stay low while the voice drifts from the target speaker. We ask why quantization hurts speech, where the damage lives, and whether it can be repaired without retraining. To find out, we run the first 4-bit weight-and-activation (W4A4) PTQ study of a TTS diffusion transformer at 1B and 3.5B. The timbre cost comes from both the weight and the activation quantization, but only the activation part has the timestep structure a precision schedule can exploit. We therefore introduce TTS-Q, which selects hard-to-quantize items from task-matched calibration candidates and applies a budget-balanced mixed-precision schedule that assigns higher precision to late-step feed-forward activations. TTS-Q recovers timbre best at both scales, at no cost to intelligibility. Separately, the deployed calibrated-W4A4 reference reduces peak memory on GPU, providing a practical reference for resource-constrained TTS deployment.

analysis.key_results: TTS-Q在两种规模下均恢复音色最佳，且不牺牲可懂度；校准W4A4参考减少GPU峰值内存。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次对1B和3.5B文本到语音扩散Transformer进行W4A4训练后量化研究，提出TTS-Q方法，通过任务匹配的校准样本选择和预算平衡的混合精度调度，修复量化导致的说话人音色损失。
analysis.method: TTS-Q：从任务匹配的校准候选中选择难量化项，并应用预算平衡的混合精度调度，为后期前馈激活分配更高精度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文首次对文本到语音扩散Transformer进行4位权重与激活量化研究，提出TTS-Q方法以修复量化对说话人音色的损害。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于文本到语音扩散Transformer的量化，不直接涉及视觉语言动作模型（VLA）或世界模型（WAM）。但其针对扩散模型训练后量化的方法（如混合精度调度）可能对VLA/WAM中的扩散组件优化具有借鉴价值。

figures.caption: Overview of TTS-Q. Coverage-guided calibration sampling selects conditions in a reference-speaker embedding space. After initial local reconstruction, speaker identity distillation compares teacher and student speech under matched text, voice prompt, and initial noise. Local reconstruction remains active on cached teacher states. The dashed purple path carries identity gradients through the frozen decoder and speaker encoder. The lower inset shows a detached prefix (student for LongCat, teacher for F5) and differentiable sampling tail. Only quantization parameters are updated. Waveforms and embedding geometry are schematic.

papers.abstract: Ultrasound examinations typically follow specific scanning protocols that require navigating through an ordered sequence of anatomical landmarks and target imaging planes. We present a local action-conditioned world model framework for goal plane probe guidance in robotic ultrasound. Autonomous ultrasound tasks often require large numbers of probe-motion trajectories for training, but collecting high-quality demonstrations is labor-intensive and explicit simulators are difficult to build because ultrasound appearance depends on contact, tissue deformation, and view-dependent acoustic artifacts. We address this problem with a two-stage model-based learning pipeline. First, a latent conditional diffusion world model predicts future ultrasound observations from recent context frames, probe motions and temporal offset. Second, a goal-conditioned temporal transformer predicts ordered probe motions and is fine-tuned using rewards from the frozen world model. Experiments on the self-collected dataset show that the world model preserves action-dependent anatomical structure on target-directed scans. In real-world closed loop experiments, the framework achieves success rates of 70.0\% for carotid guidance and 65.0\% for thyroid guidance. These results demonstrate the potential of learned ultrasound dynamics for training goal-directed robotic probe navigation within protocol-constrained organ specific tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界闭环实验中，颈动脉引导成功率为70.0%，甲状腺引导成功率为65.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个两阶段模型学习框架：先用潜在条件扩散世界模型预测未来超声观测，再用目标条件时间Transformer预测有序探头运动，并通过冻结世界模型的奖励进行微调。
analysis.method: 两阶段模型学习：第一阶段训练潜在条件扩散世界模型，根据上下文帧、探头运动和时序偏移预测未来超声图像；第二阶段训练目标条件时间Transformer预测探头运动，并使用冻结世界模型提供的奖励进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于局部动作条件世界模型的机器人超声目标平面引导框架，结合条件扩散世界模型与目标条件时间Transformer实现协议约束下的目标导向探头导航。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual state transitions and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are constrained by limited temporal context, coarse episode-level language supervision, and predominantly text-only conditioning, which hinder task-progress tracking and fine-grained language-video-action grounding while limiting visual-context reasoning and cross-embodiment transfer. In this paper, we introduce WorldScape Policy 2.0, a controllable WAM with reasoning-augmented long short-term memory. Its causal short-term visual memory supplies recent observations as DiT prefill to preserve local interaction dynamics, while its long short-term event memory organizes historical VLM outputs into global-history, local-active, and event-boundary representations for progress-aware retrieval. The retrieved history augments perception and autoregressively generated planning tokens, yielding an implicit subgoal condition for autonomous planning; semantic forcing further transfers event-level instruction semantics into this latent planning pathway. To establish fine-grained multimodal controllability, we construct ManipEvent-5M, an event-grounded embodied pretraining dataset containing nearly 5 million event segments with aligned action trajectories, episode-level task instructions, segment-level subtask captions, goal images, and video demonstrations. These designs provide a unified interface for autonomous planning from high-level instructions and controllable execution from fine-grained text, goal-image, or video-context prompts. Experiments in both simulation and real-world platforms demonstrate superior capabilities in long-horizon autonomous planning, fine-grained instruction following and in-context adaptation.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界平台上展示了在长时程自主规划、细粒度指令跟随和上下文适应方面的优越能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了WorldScape Policy 2.0，一个具有推理增强长短期记忆的可控世界行动模型，并贡献了事件基的ManipEvent-5M预训练数据集，实现了细粒度的多模态可控性和长时程自主规划能力。
analysis.method: 通过因果短期视觉记忆（DiT prefill）和事件基长期记忆（历史VLM输出组织成全局历史、局部活跃和事件边界表示）来增强感知与规划token生成；引入隐式子目标条件和语义强制机制；利用ManipEvent-5M数据集进行预训练，支持文本、目标图像和视频上下文提示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出一个可控的世界行动模型（WAM），通过因果短期视觉记忆和事件基长期记忆实现推理增强的长短期记忆机制，并结合新构建的ManipEvent-5M数据集支持自主规划与细粒度可控执行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于世界行动模型（WAM）的建模与改进，属于本站核心主题。它联合建模视觉状态转移和机器人动作，通过记忆机制和上下文学习提升长时程任务和细粒度控制能力，为WAM的自主规划与可控执行提供了有效的方案和数据集。

papers.abstract: Diffusion-based virtual try-on (VTON) often relies on segmentation-derived masks that become unreliable when the reference garment differs substantially from the target person's clothing. Existing methods may also lose fine details and commonly focus on single-garment transfer. We present TAMF-VTON, an inference-time mask-free framework built on Qwen-Image-Edit-2509. Given a person image, one or more garment images, and a text instruction, it performs single- or multi-garment transfer without masks, parsing maps, pose representations, or spatial controls at inference. Its central component is token-wise sparse Mixture-of-Experts adaptation, which provides input-dependent capacity without predefined expert roles. Timestep-weighted frequency supervision regularizes high-frequency reconstruction, while adaptive offline data construction supplies cross-category and cross-silhouette training tuples; neither is used at inference. TAMF-VTON achieves the best scores on most reported paired and unpaired metrics among evaluated VTON baselines on the standard single-garment VITON-HD and DressCode benchmarks. Selected qualitative results illustrate multi-garment composition, subject-to-subject transfer, diverse scenes, body-shape variation, and illumination changes. With INT4 on an RTX 4090, TAMF-VTON generates 1K-resolution images under 15 seconds and 2K-resolution images under 30 seconds. Our project can be accessed via https://www.style3d.ai/ai-photoshoot/virtual-clothing-try-on.

analysis.key_results: 在VITON-HD和DressCode基准上，多数配对和非配对指标优于现有方法；INT4量化后在RTX 4090上生成1K分辨率图像小于15秒，2K分辨率图像小于30秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TAMF-VTON，一个推理时无需掩码、解析图、姿态表示或空间控制的单/多服装虚拟试穿框架，核心是令牌级稀疏专家混合适配与时步加权频率监督。
analysis.method: 利用Qwen-Image-Edit-2509作为基础模型，采用令牌级稀疏专家混合适配提供输入依赖的容量，结合时步加权频率监督正则化高频重建，并用自适应离线数据构造提供跨类别和跨轮廓训练样本。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个基于Qwen-Image-Edit-2509的无需掩码的虚拟试穿框架TAMF-VTON，通过令牌级稀疏专家混合适配和离线数据构建实现单/多服装转移，并在INT4量化下实现高效推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于虚拟试穿任务中的高效推理与模型量化，与机器人VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和世界模型（WAM）无直接关联。其高效量化策略（INT4）可作为通用推理加速技术的参考，但对本站支持的具身智能主题无直接应用价值。

The second row demonstrates more challenging settings, including multi-garment composition, in-the-wild try-on, and subject-to-subject garment transfer. TAMF-VTON preserves non-try-on regions and exposed body parts with strong spatial consistency, maintaining the original background, person identity, and body structure while faithfully transferring fine-grained garment details.

papers.title: TAMF-VTON: Token-Wise Sparse Adaptation for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.title_zh: TAMF-VTON：基于令牌稀疏自适应掩码无关的虚拟试穿框架

papers.abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models increasingly rely on large cross-embodiment datasets and expressive action-generation mechanisms. In this paper, we ask whether a pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) can be adapted efficiently for robot navigation by rethinking the representation and construction of navigation actions. We introduce GemNav, a visual navigation policy that represents each robot-local waypoint coordinate as a categorical distribution over discrete metric value bins and soft-decodes it into a continuous coordinate for execution. This probabilistic representation retains likelihood information over alternative coordinate values while providing a compact action space suitable for robot navigation. We further construct training trajectories using metric-distance goal sampling rather than fixed future frame offsets, exposing the policy to varying physical navigation horizons independent of dataset frame rate and robot speed. GemNav is trained on a single 8.7-hour public SCAND dataset, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing cross-embodiment datasets. Extensive offline and closed-loop experiments show improved out-of-distribution generalization over frame-based sampling and substantially more reliable obstacle navigation than a matched continuous regression head. The same policy transfers without per-platform retraining across unseen environments and three physically distinct robot platforms.

analysis.key_results: 在单个8.7小时的SCAND数据集上训练，数据量比竞争性跨具身数据集小约三个数量级；离线实验显示比基于帧采样有更好的分布外泛化性；闭环实验中比匹配的连续回归头具有更可靠的避障导航；同一策略可在未见环境和三种物理异构机器人平台上无需每平台重新训练直接迁移。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新的导航动作表示方法，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；同时采用度量距离目标采样构建训练轨迹，使策略对物理导航距离变化具有不变性。
analysis.method: 将每个机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；使用度量距离目标采样而非固定未来帧偏移构建训练轨迹；采用多模态大语言模型作为策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GemNav提出一种基于多模态大语言模型的视觉导航策略，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标，从而在紧凑动作空间中保留似然信息。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在机器人导航中的应用，通过离散令牌化的动作表示和度量距离目标采样，为VLA在导航任务中的高效训练和泛化提供方法，与本站的VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: GemNav overview. Left: Metric-distance-based goal sampling produces eight-waypoint targets over varying physical navigation horizons, reducing dependence on frame rate and demonstrator speed. Center: LoRA adapts the vision and language towers for image, 2D pose, or image+pose goals. A task-specific prediction head jointly produces categorical coordinate distributions for eight waypoints and a navigation state in a single forward pass; soft decoding yields continuous metric waypoints (one coordinate pair shown). Right and bottom: The same checkpoint transfers without per-platform retraining to unseen environments on Spot, ANYmal, and WAVE ROVER, with the latter two being unseen embodiments.

papers.title: GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.title_zh: GemNav：利用多模态大语言模型实现离散令牌视觉机器人导航

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal trees from the top-K marginals of a factorized drafter. Weaver restores conditional dependencies between proposed tokens while avoiding a full-vocabulary projection. To support fast verification for models with Gated Delta Net layers, we derive a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm and implement optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang. By combining these model and systems contributions we achieve a 4.08-fold speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperform a highly optimized DFlash baseline by 16.3%.

analysis.key_results: 相比自回归解码实现4.08倍加速，比优化后的DFlash基线性能提升16.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Weaver，一种轻量级自回归适配器，从因子化草稿模型的前K个边际分布构建提案树，恢复条件依赖，避免全词汇投影，并针对Gated Delta Net层推出无回滚树验证算法及SGLang中的优化CUDA内核，实现4.08倍解码加速。
analysis.method: 使用轻量级自回归适配器从因子化草稿模型的top-K边际分布构建提案树；针对Gated Delta Net模型设计无回滚树验证算法并实现优化CUDA内核。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Weaver，通过轻量级自回归适配器从因子化草稿模型的top-K边际分布构建候选树，恢复条件依赖并显著提升推测解码的接受率和速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文专注于推测解码这一独立效率主题，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但其提出的高效树构建与验证方法对机器人策略模型等自回归模型的加速具有潜在方法学价值。

papers.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
papers.title_zh: 从边际分布构建树：利用因子化先验的自回归草稿生成

papers.abstract: Traditional robot programming is notoriously challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse environment configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE operates in an open-ended learning loop, consisting of three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling the agent to autonomously diagnose failures, synthesize repairs, and validate outcomes; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable robotic knowledge; and (3) an evolutionary search procedure that generates diverse programs, systematically debugging them to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite's bimanual handover task, and up to 32% on long-horizon household tasks. The accumulated skill library further enables zero-shot generalization: on representative unseen long-horizon tasks, ASPIRE achieves 31% success, outperforming the 4% success rate of prior methods. Performance scales with the capabilities of frontier models. With Claude Opus 5.5, ASPIRE nearly saturates these benchmarks, achieving 99% average success across all 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and 100% success on representative Robosuite and BEHAVIOR-1K tasks. Beyond simulation, skills discovered in simulation reduce real-world robot programming effort across embodiments and robot APIs, while skills acquired through online interaction with physical robots enable ASPIRE to solve a Rubik's Cube with progressively improving efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在扰动操控任务上比之前方法提高最多77%，在 Robosuite 双手交接任务上提高72%，在长程家庭任务上提高最多32%；在未见的代表性长程任务上达到31%的成功率（之前方法为4%）；使用 Claude Opus 5.5 时在全部80个 LIBERO-Pro 任务上平均成功率达99%，并在精选 Robosuite 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务上达到100%成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ASPIRE 系统，通过开放循环的探索、闭环执行反馈和进化搜索，自主生成并持续优化机器人技能程序，并构建可复用的技能库，显著提升操控任务性能和零样本泛化能力。
analysis.method: 系统由三部分组成：闭环机器人执行引擎提供细粒度多模态轨迹用于自动诊断和修复；持续扩展的技能库将验证过的修复提炼为可迁移知识；进化搜索过程生成多样程序并系统调试以超越单轨迹改进。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ASPIRE 是一个通过自主编写和迭代修正机器人控制代码、积累可复用技能库的持续学习系统，在仿真和真实机器人任务中大幅超越以往方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以代码即策略（code-as-policy）范式实现自主机器人技能学习，涉及视觉-语言模型、机器人操控和技能库构建，与 VLA 和机器人世界模型的研究主题高度相关，但不直接涉及高效推理或量化技术。

figures.caption: ASPIRE system overview. A coordinator spawns an actor agent (coding agent) per task, enabling parallel learning across tasks. Each actor refines and validates robot programs through iterative debugging with the robot execution engine , which exposes per-primitive multimodal traces for failure attribution and repair. Evolutionary search samples diverse candidate programs ( π 0 , … , π k \pi_{0},\ldots,\pi_{k} ), sends each through the engine, and conditions the next generation ( π 0 ′ , … , π k ′ \pi^{\prime}_{0},\ldots,\pi^{\prime}_{k} ) on surviving programs and residual failure traces. The coordinator writes validated repairs into a shared skill library , which future actors retrieve as in-context guidance; skills discovered in simulation can also be adapted as cross-embodiment guidance for real-robot programming.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Robot execution engine. Trace-guided debugging on a BEHAVIOR-1K navigate-and-pick-up-radio task. (a) Ego-view keyframes and overlays show the robot locating the radio but failing to approach it. (b) The primitive trace localizes the failure to repeated PLANNING_ERROR s: candidate navigation goals fall inside the table’s collision-avoidance buffer. (c) The agent patches the program with a multi-angle approach routine, re-perceives the radio from a reachable side, and completes the grasp. The validated repair is admitted as a reusable Multi-Angle Approach skill.

papers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.title_zh: ASPIRE：基于迭代探索的自主机器人技能编程与库构建

papers.abstract: Can the robot use a plate to cut a cake if no knife is available? Tool use greatly expands robot capabilities, but to use tools creatively beyond their intended functions, the robot faces the challenge of $\textit{open-world affordance grounding}$: select an open-category object to act as a tool and localize its specific region of action. To this end, we introduce GROW$^2$ (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training. Semantically, GROW$^2$ harnesses the commonsense reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to parse a natural-language task instruction, select a suitable object as the tool, and identify task-relevant parts on the tool and the target object. Geometrically, vision foundation models then ground the selected parts into precise 3D regions from a single RGB-D image. Experiments on established benchmarks show that GROW$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on affordance prediction benchmarks. Further, it achieves zero-shot generalization over open-category objects and outperforms baselines in both simulated and real-world robot tool use experiments.

analysis.key_results: 在既有可供性预测基准上超越最先进基线；在开放类别物体上实现零样本泛化，并在仿真与真实机器人工具使用实验中优于基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GROW²框架，利用物体部件作为抽象，将开放世界可供性定位分层为语义级别（通过VLM选择工具及相关部件）和几何级别（从单张RGB-D图像定位3D区域），无需端到端大量数据训练。
analysis.method: 利用视觉语言模型进行常识推理，解析任务指令、选择合适工具并识别相关部件；再由视觉基础模型将所选部件定位到精确的3D区域。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出GROW²框架，通过层次化地将开放世界可供性定位分解为语义选择与几何定位，使机器人能够创新性地使用工具。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人操作中的动作与工具使用，核心是通过视觉语言模型进行任务解析和物体部件定位，属于视觉语言动作（VLA）范畴，对本站的VLA主题有高度相关性，但未涉及世界模型或预测解码等效率主题。

figures.caption: GROW 2 (GROunding Which and Where) decomposes open-world affordance grounding into two levels: (i) semantic selection of an appropriate tool and the task-relevant parts, and (ii) grounding the selected parts into 3D affordance regions. This decomposition enables GROW 2 to leverage a series of foundation models and generalize to open-category objects.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: 3D affordance grounding. Our method consists of two stages: reconstructing and registering an object mesh from a single-view RGB-D observation and rendering the registered mesh from multiple viewpoints, segmenting the selected parts in each view, and fusing the resulting masks into 3D affordance regions.

papers.abstract: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 仿真基准、Unitree G1 人形机器人全身抓取放置以及 ALOHA 式双臂接触丰富任务上，VQActFlow 优于连续和离散基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VQActFlow 多任务操作策略，将动作块量化为离散码本，并通过变分流匹配生成码序列；引入推理时引导，在语言条件上使用无分类器引导，并利用学习到的码本批评器提供可行性信号来引导模式承诺。
analysis.method: 将连续动作块量化为学习到的离散码本，结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列；在推理时通过语言条件上的无分类器引导和码本批评器引导模式选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VQActFlow 通过向量量化动作块并结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列，实现对多任务机器人操作中动作模式的显式引导。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习范畴，通过向量量化动作表示与流匹配生成，在多任务机器人操作中显式建模动作模式，显著提升了策略性能和任务选择性。

figures.caption: VQActFlow framework. Stage 1: a VQ-VAE encoder tokenizes action chunks into discrete codebook indices, and a decoder reconstructs actions from the quantized embeddings. Stage 2: a VFM policy transports Gaussian noise toward codebook embeddings, maintaining an explicit preference over action modes that inference-time guidance steers, CFG toward the instructed task and a codebook critic toward feasible modes.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: VQActFlow: Vector-Quantized Action Mode Steering for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: VQActFlow：面向多任务机器人操作的向量量化动作模式引导

papers.abstract: We present ZeroDex, a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Our framework builds on the grounding ability that vision-language models (VLMs) already exhibit in 2D and lifts their predictions into 3D through multi-view fusion, which extends VLM grounding beyond image-space keypoints to the metric 3D quantities that manipulation actually requires: contact points, placement targets, and tool-motion anchors. Because execution is driven by these 3D groundings rather than a learned policy, the system preserves the VLM's open-world generalization, without collecting demonstrations or post-training for a specific task or embodiment. The VLM decomposes a complex instruction into a sequence of atomic tasks, each executed by a primitive from a small reusable library that covers manipulation tasks including pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the grounded keypoints; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and higher task success than zero-shot visual-prompting and constraint-based baselines, both of which ground from a single RGB-D view, and our demonstration-free system outperforms VLA policies fine-tuned on 100 task demonstrations. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation, where execution verification and replanning recover from intermediate failures, and show that the system generalizes to unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界实验表明三维对齐准确性和任务成功率优于单视角视觉提示和约束基线，且零样本系统性能超过基于100个任务演示微调的VLA策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ZeroDex框架，将视觉语言模型的2D语义对齐能力通过多视角融合提升到三维，实现零样本长时程灵巧操作，无需任务演示或后训练。
analysis.method: 利用视觉语言模型将复杂指令分解为原子任务序列，通过多视角RGB图像融合提取三维关键点（接触点、放置目标、工具运动锚点），并使用小型可重用原语库执行每个原子任务，包括拾放和工具使用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ZeroDex是一个零样本长时程灵巧操作框架，利用视觉语言模型的2D语义对齐能力，通过多视角融合将其提升到三维空间，从而生成可执行的3D任务计划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于VLA范畴，利用视觉语言模型进行机器人操作规划，并展示了无需微调即可超越传统VLA策略的性能，对VLA的零样本泛化和三维落地具有重要参考价值。

figures.caption: ZeroDex. Given a language instruction and calibrated multi-view observations, our framework uses multi-view VLM grounding with robust triangulation to infer task-relevant 3D groundings, generates affordance-aware dexterous grasps, and executes pick-and-place or tool-use plans through reusable action primitives.

papers.abstract: Safe control is a prerequisite for real-world embodied intelligence, for which safe reinforcement learning has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing safe reinforcement learning methods either require costly real-world exploration or depend on hand-crafted safety functions. Neither scales to vision-language-action models deployed in open-world physical environments. We propose SafeDojo, a model-based safe reinforcement learning framework that improves vision-language-action policies through world-model imagination. SafeDojo performs online reinforcement learning on top of an interactive video world model. A ResNet success classifier scores predicted future frames, while a lightweight safety head predicts per-step contact probabilities from the current latent context and proposed action chunk, jointly assessing task execution and trajectory safety. These decoupled signals are balanced through Lagrangian-constrained GRPO. On SafeLIBERO Level I, SafeDojo improves average safe-success rate by 8.25 percentage points over the strongest baseline; on the zero-shot Level II setting, it is competitive with the strongest model-free baseline. Real-world Franka deployment further shows the best average task and safe-success rates across five tasks. These results support world-model-based safe reinforcement learning as a promising path toward safer embodied intelligence.

analysis.key_results: 在SafeLIBERO Level I上，平均安全成功率比最强基线提高8.25个百分点；在零样本Level II设置上与最强无模型基线相当；真实Franka部署在五个任务中取得最佳平均任务成功率和安全成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SafeDojo框架，利用交互式视频世界模型进行在线强化学习，通过解耦的任务成功和轨迹安全信号以及拉格朗日约束的GRPO来提升VLA策略的安全性。
analysis.method: 在交互式视频世界模型上进行在线强化学习；使用ResNet成功分类器对预测未来帧评分，轻量安全头从潜在上下文和动作块预测逐步接触概率；通过拉格朗日约束的GRPO平衡两个信号。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SafeDojo提出基于世界模型想象的安全强化学习框架，在不依赖真实探索或手工安全函数的情况下提升VLA策略的安全成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接关注视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在开放世界物理环境中的安全控制，属于VLA核心主题；同时引入世界模型作为想象环境，与本站的WAM主题高度相关，是安全强化学习与VLA/WAM交叉的典型工作。

figures.caption: Overview of SafeDojo. SafeDojo enhances VLA policies with world-model-based reward–cost evaluation and safe GRPO, boosting safe success and efficiency in simulation and real-world scenarios. The performance panels compare against all baselines; complete comparisons are reported in Tables 1 and 2 .
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Detailed SafeDojo Pipeline. SafeDojo optimizes VLA policies entirely inside an interactive video world model by rolling out candidate action trajectories into imagined future dynamics. Task reward and safety cost are decoupled and optimized via Lagrangian-based constrained GRPO, improving task success while reducing safety risks without potentially damaging real-world rollouts.

papers.title_zh: SafeDojo：通过交互式世界模型实现VLA的安全强化学习

papers.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present $\mu_0$, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, $\mu_0$ forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. This TraceExtract supervision pretrains $\mu_0$ by combining a pretrained vision-language backbone with a modular trace expert, which represents each query via B-spline control points and predicts future traces. Experiments show that $\mu_0$ outperforms baselines in both 2D and 3D trace prediction, including trace prediction models and tokenized VLM methods. Because $\mu_0$ is frozen and reusable, it can be paired with action experts for downstream robot embodiments. Despite action-free pretraining, the resulting trace-conditioned policies achieve performance competitive with VLA models pretrained with action supervision, such as $\pi_0$. These results establish 3D traces as a scalable and transferable representation for cross-embodiment manipulation.

analysis.key_results: μ₀在2D和3D轨迹预测上优于基线模型（包括轨迹预测模型和token化VLM方法）；与动作专家配对后，其策略在性能上与带动作监督的VLA模型（如π₀）相当。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出μ₀，一种通过预测3D交互轨迹而非像素或动作来建模物理变化的世界模型，并在无动作监督下实现跨实施例操作。

papers.abstract: We introduce flow control of vision-language-action (VLA) models, a simple and effective way to steer VLA actions in real time through generic inputs, such as a keyboard. This method can be used out-of-the-box and does not require retraining or fine-tuning VLAs. It enables relatively crude user inputs to steer a VLA to align with user intent. Flow control writes the user input into the initial condition of the VLA's flow matching action expert. Because the flow is deterministic, integration retains information about the user input while moving it toward the action distribution learned during training, so that the generated actions reflect the user's intent (high fidelity) and stay close to the VLA's own unsteered actions (high conformity). We demonstrate that flow control has many desirable properties: (1) flow control accurately and responsively steers robot actions with user inputs, (2) it is robust to suboptimal user inputs, (3) it enables users to steer VLAs to achieve significantly higher success rates and faster task completion, and (4) fine-tuning a VLA on flow control trajectories improves the autonomous policy. Together, these results provide a simple and intuitive way for users to help steer VLA actions, increasing task performance. Project page and videos: https://jcykao.github.io/flowcontrol/.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明流控制能够准确响应地引导机器人动作，对次优用户输入具有鲁棒性，使用户能够显著提高成功率和任务完成速度，且基于流控制轨迹微调VLA可改善自主策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入流控制方法，通过将用户输入写入流匹配动作专家的初始条件，实现实时引导VLA动作，同时保持高保真度和高一致性。
analysis.method: 流控制：将用户输入写入VLA流匹配动作专家的初始条件，利用确定性流积分将输入信息移向学习到的动作分布，生成既符合用户意图又接近原始策略的动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无需重训练或微调的流控制方法，通过实时用户输入（如键盘）引导视觉-语言-动作模型的动作生成，提升任务表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型的实时交互控制，通过流匹配特性实现无需重新训练的用户引导，属于VLA高效推理与人类交互的核心主题，与本站VLA研究方向高度相关。

papers.abstract: One-step generation from standard diffusion or Flow-Matching training is rarely effective for text-to-image or video generation without distillation or specialized one-step objectives. We find that VLA action generation behaves strikingly differently. Biasing only the training timestep distribution toward the noise endpoint yields strong one-step policies across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and real-world robot tasks. Moreover, for open-source VLA models with different architectures, simply replacing iterative decoding with a single forward pass often performs comparably to the original multi-step decoding on benchmarks such as LIBERO, CALVIN, and SimplerEnv. We attribute this difference to the condition-target structure of VLA generation, which is closer to image-to-text than text-to-image: rich observations strongly constrain a comparatively compact target. We formalize this intuition through the irreducible velocity loss $R_v(t,c)$ of standard Flow Matching, which becomes much smaller toward the noise endpoint for VLA, whereas image-generation models usually exhibit a U-shaped profile. The geometry induced by the learned generative map shows the same contrast: the Jacobian of this map with respect to the initial noise has a substantially smaller largest singular value for action generation than for image generation. Together, these results suggest that VLA's condition-target structure makes one-step generation unusually accessible to standard Flow Matching. Code and training configurations for this paper are available at https://github.com/bondtesty/let-it-be-simple.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、CALVIN、SimplerEnv及真实世界机器人任务上，单步策略表现强劲，且与原始多步解码性能相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现VLA动作生成在标准Flow Matching框架下特别适合单步生成，仅通过偏置训练时间步分布即可获得强单步策略，并在多个基准上验证了其有效性。
analysis.method: 偏置训练时间步分布向噪声端点，并使用单步前向传播替代迭代解码；通过不可约速度损失和生成映射的雅可比奇异值分析解释其可行性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过将训练时间步分布偏向噪声端点，视觉-语言-动作模型可以用单步前向传播替代迭代解码，在多个机器人基准上实现性能相当的动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型的推理效率，提出单步动作生成方法，对机器人动作生成任务具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters as parameterized procedural memories during training. At inference time, VLA-Pro retrieves relevant procedural memories based on the current multi-modal context and dynamically fuses these memories for generating the current action chunk. Experiments on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-Pro consistently improves cross-task generalization across multiple backbones, achieving up to a 207% relative improvement in simulation and increasing real-world success rate from 5.8% to 65.0%. These results suggest that procedural memory retrieval and adaptation provide an effective mechanism for transferring manipulation experience to novel tasks while preserving modularity and execution stability.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin、RLBench及真实世界操作任务上，VLA-Pro在多种骨干网络下一致提升跨任务泛化，仿真中相对提升最高207%，真实世界成功率从5.8%提升至65.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的VLA-Pro框架，通过存储任务相关程序记忆并在推理时动态检索与融合，显著提升VLA模型在未见任务上的跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.method: 训练时将任务特定LoRA适配器存储为参数化程序记忆；推理时根据多模态上下文检索相关程序记忆并动态融合生成当前动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Pro框架，通过训练时存储任务特定LoRA适配器作为程序记忆并在推理时检索融合，提升视觉-语言-动作模型跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA模型的跨任务泛化，属于本站核心主题；提出的程序记忆检索与迁移机制对VLA策略学习具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion within that range. Guided by this analysis, we propose InfoQuant, a train-free method that employs Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation (PSOT) to shape activations into more quantization-friendly distributions. We further introduce adaptive outlier-token selection to improve the robustness of PSOT during optimization. Across multiple LLM families, InfoQuant consistently outperforms prior PTQ and end-to-end training baselines. Under W4A4KV4, it preserves 97% of floating-point accuracy on average and reduces the LLaMA-2 13B performance gap by 42% over the previous state of the art. Code is available at [https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant](https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant)

analysis.key_results: 在多个LLM系列上，W4A4KV4设置下平均保留97%浮点精度，并在LLaMA-2 13B上将性能差距降低42%（相比此前最优方法）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出InfoQuant，一种无需训练的PTQ方法，包含峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）和自适应离群token选择，用于塑造量化友好的激活分布。
analysis.method: 基于信息论的量化误差分析，使用峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）和自适应离群token选择来优化激活分布。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: InfoQuant提出一种无需训练的PTQ方法，通过信息论引导的激活分布设计来提升低比特量化性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于LLM的低比特量化技术，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域；但其提出的训练无关量化方法对于在资源受限的机器人硬件上部署VLA模型可能具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly rely on asynchronous inference to hide model latency behind ongoing robot motion. During inference, the robot continues executing its current action chunk while the next chunk is generated from the observation available at inference start. By the time the new chunk is executed, the robot or scene may have changed, so an action that fits the prediction-time state can be misaligned with the execution-time state. Training-time methods modify the policy input or supervised target based on the expected execution delay, but do not directly supervise how actions should change as the scene evolves between prediction and execution. Runtime repair methods improve chunk continuity or modify actions during deployment, but can still leave actions aligned with the prediction-time state rather than the execution-time state. Our key insight is that execution-time observations are unavailable when the online prediction is made but are available in recorded trajectories during offline training, making the prediction-execution mismatch observable during training. We propose DEFLECT, an offline post-training framework that turns this temporal contrast into preference supervision for a policy acting from stale inputs. Across Kinetix, LIBERO, and three real-robot tasks, DEFLECT improves delay robustness across the evaluated VLA policies and settings. At the longest supported delay, it improves success by 4.2 percentage points over VLASH on Kinetix and by 22.7 points over naive asynchronous execution with GR00T N1.7 on LIBERO.

analysis.key_results: 在Kinetix、LIBERO及三个真实机器人任务上提升了延迟鲁棒性；在最长支持延迟下，Kinetix上成功率比VLASH提高4.2个百分点，LIBERO上比GR00T N1.7的朴素异步执行提高22.7个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DEFLECT离线后训练框架，将预测-执行时间不匹配转化为对来自滞后输入的策略的偏好监督，从而直接教导动作应如何随场景演化而变化。
analysis.method: 离线利用记录轨迹中可用的执行时观测，构建时间反事实偏好，对在滞后输入上行动的策略进行偏好学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DEFLECT利用离线轨迹中的执行时观测构建时间反事实偏好监督，提升视觉-语言-动作策略在异步推理下的延迟鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA策略在实际机器人部署中的异步推理问题，属于VLA核心主题；虽然不涉及世界模型或动作-世界模型，但它贡献了一种利用执行时观测来改进策略的离线训练方法，对提升真实机器人系统中VLA的时序一致性具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in egocentric video understanding, but their ability to reason cooperatively from multiple embodied viewpoints remains largely unexplored. We study this problem through multi-robot cooperative dynamic spatial reasoning, where a model must answer spatial, temporal, visibility, and coordination questions by integrating synchronized egocentric videos from a team of moving robots. To support this setting, we introduce CoopSR, the first benchmark for this task, together with EgoTeam, a multi-robot egocentric QA dataset. EgoTeam contains 114,227 QA pairs spanning 19 question types, four difficulty tiers, and three team sizes in Habitat and iGibson, along with a real-world test set of around 2,326 QAs collected using two quadruped robots. We further propose SG-CoR (Spectral and Geometry-Aware Cooperative Reasoner), an MLLM framework for fine-grained cooperative spatial reasoning. SG-CoR combines dynamics-aware multi-robot frame sampling, spectral- and geometric-guided view fusion, and geometry- and motion-informed prompt distillation, enabling the model to benefit from privileged robot-pose supervision during training while requiring only egocentric videos at test time. Across 22 MLLM baselines, SG-CoR consistently improves cooperative reasoning, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned baseline by +3.87% on Habitat and +7.12% on iGibson. It also shows stronger generalization to unseen team sizes and real-world robot tests. Code can be found at https://github.com/KPeng9510/seeing-together.git.

analysis.key_results: SG-CoR在22个多模态大语言模型基线上一致提升协作推理性能，在Habitat上优于最强微调基线+3.87%，在iGibson上优于+7.12%，并展现出对未见团队规模和真实世界机器人测试更强的泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个多机器人协作空间推理基准CoopSR、多机器人自我中心问答数据集EgoTeam，以及SG-CoR多模态大语言模型框架。
analysis.method: SG-CoR框架结合动态感知的多机器人帧采样、基于谱与几何的视角融合，以及几何与运动信息引导的提示蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作引入首个多机器人协作动态空间推理基准CoopSR和数据集EgoTeam，并提出SG-CoR框架以提升多模态大语言模型在协作空间推理任务上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦多机器人自我中心视频的空间推理与协作，属于具身智能和视觉-语言-动作领域，其方法对多智能体下的VLA模型、机器人策略学习以及协作世界理解具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, represented by Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), jointly predict multiple visual geometry tasks such as depth estimation, camera pose prediction, and point cloud reconstruction in a single forward pass. They have been widely adopted in 3D vision applications, but their billion-scale parameters bring substantial memory and computation overhead, posing challenges for on-device deployment. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is an effective technique to reduce this overhead. Existing PTQ methods for feed-forward 3D models mainly focus on handling heavy-tailed activation distributions and constructing diverse calibration datasets. However, we observe that feed-forward 3D models predict multiple geometric attributes through a shared backbone, where different transformer blocks and hidden channels contribute distinctly to each task, resulting in substantially different sensitivities to quantization errors across tasks, blocks, and channels. Consequently, treating all tasks equally over-emphasizes insensitive tasks and causes significant accuracy loss on the sensitive ones. To address this issue, we propose Fisher-Guided Quantization (FGQ) for feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. Specifically, FGQ uses the diagonal Fisher information matrix to quantify the different sensitivities across tasks, blocks, and channels, and incorporates these sensitivities into the Learnable Affine Transformation during calibration to better preserve the channels and blocks most critical to each task. Extensive experiments across camera pose estimation, point map reconstruction, and depth estimation show that FGQ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art quantization baselines on VGGT, achieving up to 39% relative improvement under the 4-bit quantization. Code is available at https://github.com/ypzhng/FGQ.

analysis.key_results: 在VGGT上的相机姿态估计、点图重建和深度估计实验中，4位量化下FGQ相对改进最高达39%，且一致优于最先进的量化基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Fisher引导量化(FGQ)方法，利用对角Fisher信息矩阵量化不同任务、块和通道的敏感性，并通过可学习仿射变换在标定过程中保留关键部分。
analysis.method: Fisher信息矩阵引导的量化敏感度分析与可学习仿射变换相结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对VGGT等前馈3D重建模型，提出Fisher引导的量化方法，以任务、块和通道的敏感性差异优化低位量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于前馈3D重建模型的量化，属于高效推理技术，与VLA/WAM无直接联系。

papers.abstract: World models aim to improve robotic decision making by predicting the consequences of actions. However, in practice, their predictions often become unreliable once the robot encounters states outside the training distribution, limiting their effectiveness at deployment. We observe that execution itself provides a natural but underutilized signal: after each action, the robot directly observes the true next state, revealing the mismatch between predicted and actual outcomes. Building on this insight, we propose feedback world model, an inference-time mechanism that closes the loop between prediction and observation at inference time. Instead of treating the world model as a static open-loop predictor, our method maintains a lightweight feedback state that is updated online to iteratively correct future predictions, compensating for model errors using real-time observations without additional training data or parameter updates. We show that this process can be interpreted as a latent-space observer and admits convergence guarantees under bounded, asymptotically convergent dynamics residuals and a stable feedback gain. We further introduce action-aware guidance to better translate corrected predictions into control by emphasizing action-controllable components while suppressing irrelevant variations. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, Robomimic, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that our method substantially improves both prediction accuracy and policy performance under distribution shift, reducing world model prediction error by up to 76.4%. The same feedback mechanism improves the predictions of the pretrained foundation model Fast-WAM-Joint without updating its parameters, demonstrating its plug-and-play applicability. These results show that incorporating real-time feedback at inference time provides a simple yet powerful alternative to static world modeling.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO-Plus、Robomimic 和真实世界操作任务上，显著提升预测精度与策略性能，世界模型预测误差最多降低 76.4%；对预训练基础模型 Fast-WAM-Joint 同样有效。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出反馈世界模型（Feedback World Model），在推理时闭环结合真实观测以迭代校正世界模型预测，无需额外训练或参数更新。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种推理时反馈机制，通过在线利用真实观测来修正世界模型预测，从而提升机器人在分布偏移下的决策性能。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is inherently window-level and prefix-sensitive. We propose PPOW (Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing), a reinforcement learning framework that shifts drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization. PPOW combines a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing, which prioritizes informative windows with high confidence-weighted draft-target divergence. PPOW achieves average acceptance lengths of 6.29-6.52 and speedups of 3.39-4.36$\times$ across multiple model families and benchmarks under a unified decoding protocol. These results show that performance-driven window-level optimization is a practical approach to improving speculative decoding efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在多个模型家族和基准上，统一解码协议下实现了平均接受长度6.29-6.52和加速比3.39-4.36倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PPOW（Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing），一个强化学习框架，将草稿模型优化从token级模仿转向窗口级优化，结合成本感知加速奖励、分布近似奖励和自适应分歧感知窗口，提升投机解码效率。
analysis.method: PPOW框架，包含Cost-Aware Speedup Reward、Distribution-Based Proximity Reward和Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing，用强化学习训练草稿模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PPOW框架，用强化学习替代传统的有监督微调，通过窗口级优化提升投机解码的接受长度和加速比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于投机解码的效率优化，不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其高效推理方法可能对机器人策略模型（如VLA）的部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在15项原子任务、6项组合工作流和3项双手任务的基准测试中，AugSmolVLA在正常和高曝光条件下均优于ACT、X-VLA和原始SmolVLA，尤其在精确放置、透明物体操作、组合工作流和视觉退化场景。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BioProVLA-Agent系统，集成协议解析、视觉状态验证和具身执行，并开发AugSmolVLA在线增强策略提升湿实验室视觉扰动下的执行稳定性。
analysis.method: 系统由LLM协议代理、VLM-RAG验证代理和VLA具身代理组成，通过轻量级策略执行经验证的子任务；AugSmolVLA针对透明器皿、反射、光照变化和过曝进行在线增强。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个由VLA模型驱动的经济型、协议驱动、视觉增强的具身多智能体系统，用于生物实验室操作，并开发了在线增强策略AugSmolVLA以提升在视觉干扰下的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是VLA模型在生物实验室操作中的应用，不涉及WAM（世界模型），但通过多智能体闭环节点和AugSmolVLA轻量化策略，对机器人策略学习和高效推理具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: We present Move-Then-Operate, a Vision language action framework that explicitly decouples robotic manipulation into two distinct behavioral phases: coarse relocation (move) and contact-critical interaction (operate). Unlike monolithic policies that conflate these heterogeneous regimes, our architecture employs a dual-expert policy routed by a learnable phase selector, introducing a structural inductive bias that isolates phase-specific dynamics. Phase labels are automatically generated via an MLLM-based pipeline conditioned on lightweight contextual cues such as end-effector velocity and subtask decomposition to ensure alignment with human motor patterns. Evaluated on the RoboTwin2 benchmark, our method achieves an average success rate of $68.9\%$, outperforming the monolithic $\pi_0$ baseline by $24\%$. It matches or exceeds models trained on $10\times$ more data and reaches peak performance in $40\%$ fewer training steps, demonstrating that architectural disentanglement of move and operate phases is a highly effective and efficient strategy for mastering high-precision manipulation. The code is available at: https://github.com/healenrens/Move-then-Operate

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin2基准上平均成功率达68.9%，超过单体π0基线24%；与使用10倍数据训练的模型相当或更优，且在40%更少训练步数达到峰值性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 显式将机器人操作分解为移动与操作两个行为阶段，并设计双专家策略与可学习阶段选择器，引入结构归纳偏置以隔离阶段动态。
analysis.method: 双专家策略路由由可学习阶段选择器控制；阶段标签通过基于MLLM的自动标注流程生成，利用末端执行器速度和子任务分解等轻量上下文线索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Move-Then-Operate框架，将机器人操作解耦为粗定位移动和接触关键操作两个阶段，通过可学习阶段选择器路由双专家策略，在RoboTwin2上显著优于单体基线。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，提出了一种通过显式行为阶段解耦来提升高精度操作任务性能与训练效率的方法，对本站VLA主题有核心贡献。

papers.abstract: Recent advancements in learning from human demonstration have shown promising results in addressing the scalability and high cost of data collection required to train robust visuomotor policies. However, existing approaches are often constrained by a reliance on multiview camera setups, depth sensors, or custom hardware, and are typically limited to policy execution from third-person or egocentric cameras. In this paper, we present WARPED, a framework designed to synthesize realistic wrist-view observations and actions from human demonstration videos to facilitate the training of visuomotor policies using only monocular RGB data. With data collected from an egocentric RGB camera, our system leverages vision foundation models to initialize the interactive scene. A hand-object interaction pipeline is then employed to track the hand and manipulated object and retarget the trajectories to a robotic end-effector. Lastly, photorealistic wrist-view observations are synthesized via Gaussian Splatting to directly train a robotic policy. We demonstrate that WARPED achieves success rates comparable to teleoperation on four of five rigid-object tabletop tasks and one articulated-object task, while requiring 4-9x less data collection time.

analysis.key_results: 在五个刚性物体桌面任务中的四个以及一个关节物体任务上，成功率与遥操作相当，数据收集时间减少4-9倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出WARPED框架，利用视觉基础模型初始化交互场景，通过手-物交互管线追踪手和操作物体并重定目标到机器人末端执行器，使用高斯泼溅合成逼真手腕视角，仅靠单目RGB数据即可训练机器人策略。
analysis.method: 利用视觉基础模型初始化场景，手-物交互管线追踪和重定向，高斯泼溅合成手腕视角观测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个从人类演示视频合成逼真手腕视角观测和动作的框架，仅使用单目RGB数据训练机器人视触觉运动策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人操作学习（仿VLA），通过从人类自我中心视频生成手腕视角数据来训练视触觉运动策略，不涉及WAM。
