papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes pi0.5 execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10--15\,cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to six VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over 420{,}000+ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific (pi0.5 per-token, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://github.com/CWRU-AISM/action-atlas

analysis.key_results: 注入任务A的激活可使pi0.5在99.6%的episodes中执行任务A的轨迹；物理UR10e上定向重放成功率26/26和18/26；移动源物体10-15cm后，50/50试验在记录坐标处抓取；每个架构编码指令，四个模型将指令权重置于视觉之下；目标选择与运动生成在可区分时分离。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一套可解释性流水线，定位并操控VLA策略中的内部特征，证明注入任务A的激活可使pi0.5在任务B场景中执行任务A的轨迹，并发现模型将指令编码与视觉信息分离。
analysis.method: 因果干预、稀疏自编码器（SAE）、激活注入、定向重放，并在多个基准（LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv、ALOHA）上对六种VLA模型进行超过420,000次实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文通过因果干预和稀疏自编码器，对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行可解释性分析，揭示了模型的内部工作机制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文主题为VLA策略的可解释性分析，通过因果干预揭示VLA内部特征如何绑定绝对坐标并导致分布外脆弱性，对理解VLA的工作机制和提升鲁棒性具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely primarily on RGB perception, preventing them from capturing modalities such as thermal signals that are imperceptible to conventional visual sensors. Moreover, end-to-end generative policies lack explicit safety constraints, making them fragile when encountering obstacles and novel scenarios outside the training distribution. To address these limitations, we propose Safe-Night VLA, a multimodal manipulation framework that enables robots to see the unseen while enforcing rigorous safety constraints for thermal-aware manipulation in unstructured environments. Specifically, Safe-Night VLA integrates long-wave infrared thermal perception into a pre-trained vision-language backbone, enabling semantic reasoning grounded in thermodynamic properties. To ensure safe execution under out-of-distribution conditions, we incorporate a safety filter via control barrier functions, which provide deterministic workspace constraint enforcement during policy execution. We validate our framework through real-world experiments on a Franka manipulator, introducing a novel evaluation paradigm featuring temperature-conditioned manipulation, subsurface target localization, and reflection disambiguation, while maintaining constrained execution at inference time. Results demonstrate that Safe-Night VLA outperforms RGB-only baselines and provide empirical evidence that foundation models can effectively leverage non-visible physical modalities for robust manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在Franka机械臂上进行的真实世界实验表明，Safe-Night VLA优于仅使用RGB的基线模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Safe-Night VLA框架，将长波红外热感知融入预训练视觉-语言骨干，并利用控制障碍函数实现安全约束。
analysis.method: 使用预训练视觉-语言骨干进行语义推理，整合长波红外热感知，并添加控制障碍函数安全过滤器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Safe-Night VLA整合长波红外热感知与安全过滤器，实现热感知安全操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究VLA模型，通过融入热感知增强操作安全性，对VLA领域具有重要价值。

papers.abstract: As neural networks continue to scale, low-precision quantization is widely adopted in edge accelerators, but conventional multi-threshold activation hardware requires 2^n-1 thresholds for n-bit integer outputs, leading to rapidly increasing hardware costs. We propose GRAU, a Generic Runtime-Reconfigurable Activation-Requantization Unit that fuses batch normalization, nonlinear activation, and requantization through piecewise-linear fitting with Power-of-Two slopes. GRAU requires only basic comparators and 1-bit right shifters, while supporting mixed-precision quantization and runtime switching among post-accumulation functions, including modern nonlinear activations such as SiLU and GELU. Compared with multi-threshold activation-requantization units, GRAU reduces LUT consumption by approximately 90% or more while improving hardware efficiency, flexibility, and scalability. We further explore the trade-off between accuracy and hardware cost across different approximation settings and provide an open-source toolchain for GRAU-aware network training.

analysis.key_results: 与多阈值激活再量化单元相比，GRAU将LUT消耗降低约90%或更多，同时提升硬件效率、灵活性和可扩展性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GRAU，通过2的幂斜率分段线性拟合融合批归一化、激活和再量化，仅需基本比较器和1位移位器即可支持混合精度和多种激活函数，并大幅降低LUT消耗。
analysis.method: 使用2的幂斜率分段线性拟合，实现批归一化、非线性激活和再量化的融合，硬件上仅需比较器和1位右移器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种融合批归一化、非线性激活和再量化的通用运行时可重构激活再量化硬件单元GRAU，以支持混合精度量化并降低硬件成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于量化神经网络加速器的高效硬件设计，不直接涉及VLA/WAM或机器人策略，但作为模型量化技术，可为VLA/WAM模型在边缘设备的部署提供潜在的能效和面积优化。

papers.abstract: One-Step Diffusion Models have demonstrated promising capability and fast inference in video super-resolution (VSR) for real-world. Nevertheless, the substantial model size and high computational cost of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) limit downstream applications. While low-bit quantization is a common approach for model compression, the effectiveness of quantized models is challenged by the high dynamic range of input latent and diverse layer behaviors. To deal with these challenges, we introduce LSGQuant, a layer-sensitivity guided quantizing approach for one-step diffusion-based real-world VSR. Our method incorporates a Dynamic Range Adaptive Quantizer (DRAQ) to fit video token activations. Furthermore, we estimate layer sensitivity and implement a Variance-Oriented Layer Training Strategy (VOLTS) by analyzing layer-wise statistics in calibration. We also introduce Quantization-Aware Optimization (QAO) to jointly refine the quantized branch and a retained high-precision branch. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method has nearly performance to origin model with full-precision and significantly exceeds existing quantization techniques. Code is available at: https://github.com/zhengchen1999/LSGQuant.

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界视频超分辨率任务上，量化后模型性能接近全精度模型，且显著优于现有量化技术。
analysis.main_contribution: 针对一步扩散视频超分辨率模型，提出LSGQuant量化框架，结合动态范围自适应量化器、面向方差的层训练策略和量化感知优化，显著优于现有量化方法。
analysis.method: LSGQuant包含动态范围自适应量化器（DRAQ）、方差导向的层训练策略（VOLTS）和量化感知优化（QAO），联合保留高精度分支进行校准和训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LSGQuant，一种层敏感度引导的量化方法，用于压缩一步扩散视频超分辨率模型并保持性能。

papers.title: LSGQuant: Layer-Sensitivity Guided Quantization for One-Step Diffusion Real-World Video Super-Resolution
papers.title_zh: LSGQuant：面向一步扩散真实世界视频超分辨率的层敏感度引导量化

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods for large language models compress pretrained weights to low bit-widths without retraining by optimizing layer-local proxy objectives. Activation-aware scaling methods such as AWQ protect input channels with large activation norms, whereas second-order error-compensation methods such as GPTQ redistribute rounding error using the inverse of the unweighted input covariance matrix. We show that both paradigms -- along with diagonal Fisher quantization, block reconstruction, and Hadamard rotation methods -- are special cases of minimizing a single loss-derived quadratic form governed by gradient-weighted activation sensitivity. From a Gauss-Newton expansion of the task loss at a linear layer $Y = X W^\top$, we prove that under isotropic output curvature the expected excess loss from weight perturbation $\Delta W$ reduces to $\frac{1}{2 d_{\mathrm{out}}}\operatorname{Tr}(\Delta W H_D \Delta W^\top)$, where $H_D = \frac{1}{n} X^\top D X$ weights each calibration token's outer product by its squared output-gradient norm $D_{tt} = \|\nabla_{y_t}\mathcal{L}\|_2^2$. Within this framework, AWQ corresponds to a diagonal approximation of $H_D$ with uniform token weights ($D = I_n$) optimized via channel scaling, while GPTQ corresponds to Cholesky error compensation on $H_D$ under $D = I_n$. We derive closed-form optimal scaling exponents for diagonal sensitivity protection, formulate sensitivity-weighted Cholesky quantization (SAQ-GPTQ) on $H_D$, and prove bounds on token-gradient heterogeneity bias, cross-layer error amplification across residual blocks, and finite-sample calibration concentration. Controlled numerical simulations confirm that under token-gradient heterogeneity, replacing $X^\top X$ with $X^\top D X$ preserves $>99\%$ top-channel saliency recall and reduces INT3/INT4 excess loss by roughly $3\times$ over unweighted GPTQ.

analysis.key_results: 在控制数值模拟中，在 token 梯度异质性条件下，用 X^T D X 替换 X^T X 可保留超过99%的顶级通道显著性召回率，并将 INT3/INT4 超额损失减少约3倍（相较于未加权 GPTQ）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个统一的框架，将AWQ、GPTQ等多种训练后量化方法解释为最小化由梯度加权激活灵敏度所控制的同一二次形式，并证明在输出曲率各向同性的条件下，期望超额损失可简化为基于加权输入协方差矩阵的表达式。
analysis.method: 通过高斯-牛顿展开与推导，构造了由梯度加权的激活灵敏度矩阵 H_D = X^T D X / n，其中 D 为输出梯度平方范数作为对角权重。在此框架下，AWQ 被解释为具有均匀 token 权重的对角近似，GPTQ 则是在该矩阵上的 Cholesky误差补偿；进而推导出对角灵敏度保护的最优缩放指数公式，并提出灵敏度加权的 Cholesky 量化方法 SAQ-GPTQ。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文将多种训练后量化方法统一为最小化由梯度加权激活灵敏度控制的损失导出二次形式，并基于此提出灵敏度加权的Cholesky量化（SAQ-GPTQ）。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于大型语言模型的训练后量化，属于独立的模型压缩效率主题，未涉及 VLA、世界模型或机器人学。其方法对量化模型推理具有普遍价值，可能为后续在机器人策略上的应用提供基础，但摘要中未建立直接联系。

papers.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. Offloading experts to host memory creates a severe PCIe I/O bottleneck because data-dependent routing keeps transfers on the critical path. We present Specter, an inference system that uses quantization to combine speculative decoding with expert offloading. Its lightweight quantized draft model runs efficiently on device while preserving high-fidelity expert activation patterns. This provides accurate multi-step lookahead over future expert usage, allowing the runtime to organize expert movement and execution ahead of verification and improve both communication and execution efficiency. Under single-request inference, Specter achieves an average 1.50x (up to 1.88x) speedup in time per output token (TPOT) over the state-of-the-art system. Specter makes memory-constrained, single-GPU MoE inference more practical on commodity hardware. Our code is available at https://github.com/wwwwwf/specter_asplos.

analysis.key_results: 在单请求推理中，相比现有最先进系统，TPOT平均加速1.50倍，最高1.88倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Specter推理系统，将量化与推测解码结合用于专家卸载，通过精确的多步预测优化通信与执行效率，单请求推理下TPOT平均加速达1.50倍。
analysis.method: 使用轻量量化草稿模型在设备上高效运行，保持高保真专家激活模式，实现多步前瞻预测未来专家使用，从而预先组织专家移动和执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Specter利用量化草稿模型实现多步推测解码，结合专家卸载以加速单GPU上的MoE推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用MoE模型的高效推理，不直接涉及VLA或WAM；但所提出的量化与推测解码结合方法可为VLA/WAM等大型模型的边缘部署提供效率优化思路。

figures.caption: Conventional offloading versus Specter . Aligned quantized speculative decoding lays the foundation for accurate prefetching and efficient system design. Two diagrams and timelines contrast intra-token prefetching with multi-step speculative offloading. The conventional path alternates PCIe transfers and GPU inference, leaving idle intervals. The Specter path uses a quantized draft model to produce candidate tokens and an expert lookahead list, allowing expert prefetching to overlap with drafting and target verification.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: The generalization of vision-language-action (VLA) models heavily relies on diverse training data. However, acquiring large-scale robot manipulation data across varied object appearances is costly and labor-intensive. To address this, we introduce Embodied Manipulation Media Adaptation (EMMA), a framework for augmenting VLA policies that combines a generative data engine with an effective training pipeline. We introduce DreamTransfer, a diffusion Transformer-based architecture for generating multi-view consistent and geometrically plausible embodied manipulation videos. It supports text-driven video editing on foreground, background and lighting while preserving 3D structure and geometric fidelity. We also utilize a hybrid training set of real and generated data and propose AdaMix to enhance the training process. AdaMix is a training strategy that adaptively weights samples according to policy performance to emphasize challenging samples. Evaluations show DreamTransfer outperforms previous video generation models in multi-view consistency, geometric fidelity, and text-conditioning precision. In real-world robotic tasks with zero-shot visual settings, our framework achieves a relative performance increase of over 92% compared to training with real data alone, and improves by an additional 17% with AdaMix.

analysis.key_results: 在真实机器人零样本视觉任务中，相对仅用真实数据训练，性能提升超过92%；加入AdaMix后额外提升17%；DreamTransfer在多项指标上优于现有视频生成模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入EMMA框架，结合扩散Transformer生成多视角一致的具身操作视频和自适应训练策略，显著提升VLA模型在真实机器人零样本视觉任务中的鲁棒性。
analysis.method: DreamTransfer生成多视角一致、几何合理的操作视频，支持文本驱动的编辑；AdaMix根据策略表现对样本进行自适应加权；混合真实与生成数据进行训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出EMMA框架，通过生成式数据引擎DreamTransfer和训练策略AdaMix增强VLA策略的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA策略的数据增强和训练改进，属于VLA的核心研究，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: DreamTransfer demonstrates strong controllability in embodied manipulation video generation. It excels in text-guided appearance editing while preserving 3D structure and geometric plausibility, and supports both real-to-real and sim-to-real transfer. The first column: real-world and simulation data. Next two columns: diverse data generated by DreamTransfer from the first column.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the EMMA framework. First, DreamTransfer generates multi-view consistent videos via text-guided visual editing of the foreground, background, and lighting conditions, conditioned on depth and text prompts. The generated videos are then evaluated by a video quality filter. Low-quality videos are initially assigned zero sampling weight to stabilize early-stage training. The AdaMix module further adaptively reweights training samples based on trajectory quality metrics, up-weighting challenging samples to improve policy robustness and generalization.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: For large language models (LLMs), post-training quantization (PTQ) significantly reduces memory and computational overhead. Despite rapid advancements, existing papers often lack experiments on the same ground. In addition, since quantization solutions typically contain multiple components, it is important to analyze the connections among numerous existing methods to gain an in-depth understanding of this field. To bridge these gaps, we conduct an up-to-date and extensive review of the state-of-the-art methods and perform comprehensive evaluations of low-bit quantization on representative text-only LLMs on the same ground to ensure fair comparisons. To our knowledge, this fair and extensive investigation remains critically important yet significantly underexplored in the research community. To better understand the connections, we first decouple published quantization into two steps: pre-quantization transformation to reduce outliers, and quantization error mitigation to offset performance loss. Second, we extensively evaluate the impact of quantization settings, including granularity and symmetry. Third, we analyze the performance of the latest MXFP4 and NVFP4 data formats. Our experimental results first demonstrate that optimizing rotation and scaling yields the best pre-quantization transformation, while combining low-rank compensation with GPTQ occasionally outperforms using GPTQ alone. Second, we verify that finer granularity improves performance at the cost of storage and asymmetric quantization benefits activations significantly more than weights. Third, we find that the format and precision of scaling factors have a significant impact on performance; notably, rotation-based transformation is effective for INT4 but demonstrates little improvement for MXFP4 and NVFP4, inspiring further investigation in this field.

analysis.key_results: 旋转和缩放结合是最优的预量化变换；低秩补偿与GPTQ结合有时优于单独使用GPTQ；更细粒度提升性能但增加存储；非对称量化对激活值的益处大于权重；缩放因子的格式和精度显著影响性能；旋转变换对INT4有效，但对MXFP4和NVFP4提升甚微。
analysis.main_contribution: 在统一基准上对现有低比特量化方法进行全面评估，并将量化流程解耦为预量化变换和量化误差缓解两个步骤，深入分析各组件之间的关联。
analysis.method: 对代表性纯文本大语言模型进行低比特量化，解耦量化方法为预量化变换（旋转、缩放）与量化误差缓解（低秩补偿、GPTQ等），并评估量化设置（粒度、对称性）及MXFP4/NVFP4格式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文对大语言模型的低比特后训练量化方法进行了公平、全面的评估，并解耦现有技术以分析其内在联系。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于通用大语言模型的量化评估，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域；但作为独立效率主题，其量化方法和评估框架对VLA/WAM中的模型压缩具有潜在参考价值。
